tei:div.tei:p: bkab nas/ rang gi gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis bsrungs la/ log pa'i spyod pa spangs nas ci bde bar spyad do/ /dus thams cad du sgrub pa la brtson pa dang*/ ma yengs pa gal che'o/ /de ltar rtag tu bsgrubs pas grub pa'i mtshan ma 'byung bar 'gyur te

| rab nag po chen po dang lha mo dngos su mthong ba'am/ rmi lam du zhal bstan nas ci 'dod pa ster ba la sogs pa 'byung la/ 'bring du yang rten de las sgra dang*/ 'od 'byung ba dang*/ tha mar yang rmi lam ltas su/ srog chags gdug pa can bsad pa dang*/ mi sha dmar po za ba dang*/ go mtshon bzang po thogs pa'i dmag gi dpung chen pos bdag la bskor nas/ bdag gi don sgrub pa la sogs pa rnams ni grub pa'i rtags yin no/ /de dag gis ni sgrub pa'i cho ga bstan zin to// // gsum pa las la sbyar ba ni/ rgyud las/ tsha ba gsum gyis gzugs brnyan ni/ /byas nas lus la tsher mas dgang*/ /dug dang ske sogs kyis bri nas | de ni gong gi ming gis ni/ /de nas me la gdung bar bya/ (《 zha 》+ de yi dus na mi snang 'gyur/ ) / zhes gsungs pa'i don ni/ thog mar liṅga bshams par bya ste/ bag phye la lcags phye zangs phye rdo phye/ dgra bo'i rkang rjes kyi rdul dang dri ma gang rnyed dang*/ tsha ba gsum ni/ dbyi mong*/ srub kalce tsha ba gsum mo/ /de dag spags pa las liṅga sor brgyad pa/ skye mched rnams gsal zhing yongs su rdzogs par byas la gdug pa can gyi shing las byung ba'i tsher mas lus la ci rigs par dgang bar bya'o/ /de nas de'i snying gar 'khor lo gzhug par bya ste/ mi'i lpags pa'am rlung gis khyer ba'i shing shun la khrag dang ske tshe dang*/ grir shi ba'i khrag dang*/ rgya skyegs kyi khu ba rnams kyis snag tsha byas la/ des 'khor lo rtsibs drug pa lte ba dang mu khyud dang bcas pa bri/ de'i rtsibs drug la/ i daṃ duṣ+taṃ che ge mo dī na me ke na mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa ces bri/ lte bar gzungs ring spel tshig dang bcas pa bris la rab tu gnas pa ni/ rang lhag pa'i lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas mdun du 'khor lo bzhag la/ swa bhā was stong par bsam/ ∶ de'i (《 zha 》 - de'i ) ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las 'khor lo ji ltar bris pa bzhin bskyed nas/

rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ dang 'khor lo'i yig 'bru'i tshogs las 'od zer gyi snang bas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi 'khor lo'i rnam pa dang*/ yig 'bru'i rnam pa du ma spyan drangs nas mdun du bskyed pa dang gnyis su med par bstim nas/ mchod pa lngas mchod pas gzi brjid dang ldan par 'gyur te/ de'i lte ba'i gzungs las pho nya khro bo'i tshogs lcags kyu dang zhags pa la sogs pa lag cha du ma 'dzin pa spros pas bsgrub bya gang na yod pa'i gnas nas rang dbang med par rlung gi shugs kyis bkug nas dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ ho: zhes bya ba phyag rgya dang bcas pa yang yang du kho'i ming yig la bstim par bya'o/ /de nas 'khor lo legs par dril la shan pas phyin ci log tu bkal ba'i skud pas rgya gram du dkris nas/ liṅga'i snying gar bcug la spra tshil bzhu bas byugs te/ bshang lam nas lcags kyi thur mas snying ga'i 'khor lo la ma song bar bu ga byas la/ de bsgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal gyi lho phyogs su 'brub khung gru gsum pa/ rgya dang dpangs su mtheb sor bcu gsum pa'i tshad dang ldan pa la dur khrod kyi sol bas byugs pa'i nang du bzhag nas/ rdo leb la sna tshogs rdo rje bris pas dgag par bya'o/ /de nas rabs chad dam mdze pho'i thod pa'i nang du yungs dkar dang khrag sna dang dug sna dang thal chen bsres pas bkang ba'i thun rdzas bsham par bya'o/ /de dag ni sngon 'gro'o/ /de nas dngos gzhi'i bya ba ni/ rang lhag pa'i lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ mdun gyi nag po chen po dang lha mo gsal bar dmigs la/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas mgon po dang lha mo'i thugs kar phog pas rgyud bskul nas/ de'i thugs ka nas sngags me stag gi rnam pa tsha zhing rtsub pa dpag tu med pa 'phros nas mdun gyi thun rdzas la thim pas/ thun rdzas khro bo'i rnam pa rab tu khros pa/ mtshon cha du ma 'dzin pa me 'bar zhing me stag 'phro ba dpag tu med par gyur par bsam zhing*/

snying po'i sngags gtso bor gyur pa gzungs ring dang lha mo'i bzlas pa ci nus pa bzlas par bya'o/ /de nas thun gyi rjes su liṅga kha phye la swa bhā was stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las ṇi'i yi ger gyur pa'am/ ming gi dang po'i yi ger gyur pa las bsgrub bya dbang po dang skye mched yongs su rdzogs par bskyed la/ gong bzhin rnam par shes pa yang nas yang du bstim nas liṅga de nyid der nges par dmigs la/ dngos su thun rdzas kyis brab cing*/ yid kyis thun rdzas rnams khro bo dang me'i phung po tsha zhing rab tu gdungs pas dgra bgegs kyi lus la brabs pas lus thal ba'i phung por byas/ sems kyi sdig sgrib thams cad bsreg par bsam zhing drag tu brab par bya'o/ /de'i tshe nag po chen po dang*/ lha mo'i thugs ka nas spros pa'i khro bo mda' dang*/ mdung dang*/ ral gri dang*/ tho lum me 'bar ba du ma thogs pa byung nas/ de rnams kyis bsgrub bya'i lus la mtshon gyi char phab par bsam zhing gzungs ring gi mthar/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya che ge mo mā ra ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces ci nus bzla bar bya'o/ / de'i mthar lha mo'i sngags spel tshig dang bcas pa bzla'o/ /mthar bsgrub bya'i rnam shes mi bskyod pa'i zhing du sangs rgyas/ lus thal ba'i rang bzhin du gyur pa bsams la lha mchod de bzod par gsol nas/ pho nya de rnams de'i thugs kar bsdu/ liṅga kha bcad la ∶ gtor ma (《 zha 》 rtag gtor ) la sogs pas mnan/ rang ci bder spyad/ de lta bu thun bzhi 'am drug gis nges par bsgrub/ ci zhig ltar na liṅga 'gul ba la sogs pa'i rtags byung na mes gdung bar bya ste/ phyi dro'i dus su mchod pa dang*/ gtor ma sngon du song nas 'bras kyi phub ma dur khrod kyi me spar ba du ba yal ba la/ nag po chen po'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba 'phros nas thim pas me de tsha zhing gdung bar bsam mo

| | de lcags kyi thur mas liṅga'i bshang lam nas btsugs nas/ bdag gi lag pa g.yon pas bzung la bla log sgyur zhing spra tshil ma zhu tsam du me la gdungs la/ lag pa g.yas pas phreng ba'i grangs bzung zhing*/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya che ge mo mā ra ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bzla zhing nam phyed la thug gi bar du bsgrub par bya'o/ /de nas liṅga 'brub khung du bcug nas sna tshogs rdo rjes kha bcad me ma shi bar bya'o/ /de lta bu zhag bdun byas pas/ de yi tshe na mi snang 'gyur/ / zhes shes par bya'o/ /gal te des kyang de ltar ma gyur na sbyin sreg gi cho ga brtsam par bya ste/ rje btsun bla mas drag po'i sbyin sreg gi yi ge mdzad pa ltar nyams su blang bar bya ste/ dus ni nyi shu dgu'i nam phyed do/ /bsreg rdzas ni tsher ma sna tshogs dang*/ thang phrom gyi 'bras bu/ yungs dkar yungs nag lcags phye/ zangs phye/ rdo breg gi phye ma/ khrag sna dug sna/ gong gi thun rdzas dang liṅga'i dum bu rnams so/ /sngags ni gong du bstan pa nyid do/ /de dag ni khyad par ro/ / gzhan ni gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /mthar nag po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa la mchod pa dang gtor ma chen pos mnyes par byas la gsol ba gdab/ maṇ+ḍal gyi lha gshegs su gsol/ sbyin sreg gi thal ba rnams lam gyi bzhi mdo'am mchod rten gyi 'og tu mnan par bya'o/ /sgrub pa'i skabs rnams su lha 'dre za lam bstan pa'i phyir dgra'i phyogs su gtor zor 'phang ngo*/ /ji srid grub pa'i bar de srid du bsgrub par bya'o/ /dbang bskur ba phyin ci ma log par thob cing*/ dam tshig dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ bla ma dam pa'i sku dgrar gyur pa dang*/ bstan pa spyi la gnod par byed pa dang*/ sems can mang po la 'tshe bar byed pa'i gdug pa can mthong na/ zhi ba'i sgo nas yang nas yang du bzlog par bya'o/ /de ltar byas kyang bzlog par ma nus na/ bla ma'am yi dam la zhus te/

byams pa dang snying rjes kun nas bslangs nas thabs la mkhas pa'i khyad par dang ldan par ∶ bya'o/ / (《 zha 》 bya'i ) bdag nyid dang zhe 'gras pa tsam gyis zhe sdang gis kun nas bslangs te bsgrubs na nyes pa chen por 'gyur bas dus nam yang de ltar mi bya'o/ /theg pa chen po'i chos kyi rtsa ba snying rje yin zhing | gsang sngags kyi lam gyi mthar thug bla ma yin pas snying rje chen po dang dad pa chen pos bsgrubs na bdag nyid kyang gnas skabs kyi ched du bya ba 'grub cing*/ lam gyi grogs su 'gyur la/ bsgrub bya'i sdig pa sbyaung ba'i mchog tu 'gyur ro/ /de dag gis ni las la sbyar ba bstan zin to/ /de ltar bstan 'di bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung*/ /grub pa'i skyes bu rnams las brgyud gyur zhing | | bla ma'i zhal las legs par rnyed pa 'di/ /don zab brnyed dka' dman pa'i yul min pas/ /yi ger bkod pa mi rigs de lta na'ang*/ /don gnyer skye bo 'ga' yis rab bskul nas/ /bla ma rdor 'dzin sras dang bcas rnams la/ /gus pas mchod de gsol ba btab nas 'dir/ /dad dang brtse ba'i bsam pas bdag gis bris/ /mi shes bag med nyon mongs dbang gyur pa | | bdag blos nyes pa gang dang ci mchis pa/ /de kun dpal ldan bla ma dam pa dang*/ /rgyal dang de sras mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams dang*/ /nag po chen po 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis/ /brtse ba chen pos bzod par mdzad nas kyang*// rnam pa kun tu bdag la byin gyis rlobs/ /de las byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba des | | bdud kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad rab bcom nas/ /bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob gyur te/ /lus can kun gyi skyabs su bdag gyur cig /'di ni legs par brtags pa yis/ /skye bo 'ga' la sbyin bya yi/ /kun la nam yang ma yin no/ /shes ldan dag gis bag yod byos/ /gal te 'di ni skal med la// byin zhing dam tshig las 'das na/ /nag po chen po'i zangs gri yis/

/de yi snying yang dgas par gyis/ /bla ma la gus tshul bzhin spyod/ /dam tshig la gnas sgrub pa pos/ /ji srid byang chub thob kyi bar/ /de srid de yi don kun sgrubs | | dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral gyi sgrub pa'i thabs 'di ni bla ma'i gsung las ji ltar byung ba bzhin/ gzhan gyis gsol ba btab pa'i ngor rdo rje 'dzin pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ chu pho byi ba'i lo la me nyag gi yul du sbyar ba rdzogs so// // ༄༅/ /bdud rtsi lnga mchod bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dgra bgegs rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /rak+ta'i rgya mtsho rab bskyil ba/ /lbu ba'i phreng ba 'khrigs pa yi/ /ar+ghaṃ mchog gi mchod pa 'di/ /dpal ldan ma hā kā la dang | | 'dod khams dbang phyug ma la 'bul/ /dam tshig dbang gis bzhes nas kyang*/ /bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod/ /oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya/ ma hā kā li de wī ye/ ma hā rak+ta sa mu dra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ dgra bgegs rnams kyis mig dang ni/ /rna ba dang ni de bzhin sna/ /lce dang tsit+ta yang dag ldan/ /dbang po lnga yi me tog 'di/ /dpal ldan ma hā kā la dang*/ /'dod khams dbang phyug ma la 'bul/ /dam tshig dbang gis bzhes nas kyang*/ /bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod/ /oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya ma hā kā l̥̄ de wī ye/ pañtsa in+d+ra gu h+ya puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ dgra bgegs rnams kyi tshil chen po/ /bdud rtsi lnga dang yang dag ldan// byin za chen por bsregs pa yi/ /bdug pa'i sprin gyi mchod pa 'di/ /dpal ldan ma hā kā la dang*/ /'dod khams dbang phyug ma la 'bul/ /dam tshig dbang gis bzhes nas kyang*/ /bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod/ /oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya (《 lu 》 ye ) / ma hā kā lī de wī ye/ ma hā me da gu h+ya dhu pe āḥhūm̐/ dgra bgegs rnams kyi sbrang chen po/ /sra ba'i ras kyi sdong bur bcas/

/yi dwags me yis sbar ba yi/ /snang gsal mchog gi mchod pa 'di/ /dpal ldan ma hā kā la dang | | 'dod khams dbang phyug ma la 'bul/ /dam tshig dbang gis bzhes nas kyang*/ /bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod/ /oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya/ ma hā kā lī de wī ye/ ma hā ma dhu ra gu h+ya ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ dgra bgegs rnams kyi khrag dang zhag /bdud rtsi lnga yis yang dag sbags/ /nus pa mchog dang rab ldan pa | | rab tu sbyar ba'i dri mchog 'di/ /dpal ldan ma hā kā la dang*/ /'dod khams dbang phyug ma la 'bul/ /dam tshig dbang gis bzhes nas kyang*/ / bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod/ /oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya/ ma hā kā lī de wī ye | ma hā ba sa ru dhi ra gu h+ya gan+dhe āḥhūm̐/ dgra bgegs rnams kyi sha rus kyi/ / bza' ba khrag gi btung ba ldan/ /ri rab rgya mtshor mnyam pa yi/ /ro brgya ldan pa'i mchod pa 'di/ /dpal ldan ma hā kā la dang*/ /'dod khams dbang phyug ma la 'bul/ /dam tshig dbang gis bzhes nas kyang*/ /bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod/ /oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya/ ma hā kā lī de wī ye/ ma hā maṃ sa rak+ta/ bhuñdza tha/ pi pa tha āḥhūm̐/ dril bu dam tshig skul ba'i sgra/ /rnga chen kun nas brjid pa'i sgra/ /dung chen gling bu snyan pa'i sgra/ /cang te'u phrin las skul ba'i sgra | | gsang ba'i rngai'u chung dbang sdud sgra/ /sna tshogs rol mo mchod pa'i sgra/ / 'jigs byed chen po mnyes byed pa'i/ /zab brjid snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs 'di/ / dpal ldan ma hā kā la dang*/ /'dod khams dbang phyug ma la 'bul/ /dam tshig dbang gis bzhes nas kyang*/ /bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod/ /oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya/ ma hā kā lī de wī ye shab+da pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ g.yang gzhi'i bla re nam mkha'i rgyan/ /rgyu rlon lda ldi bar snang rgyan/ /keng rus phreng ba sa gzhi'i rgyan | | phyag rgya rnam drug sku yi rgyan/

/'jigs byed chen po mnyes byed pa'i/ / bla na med pa'i mchod pa 'di/ /dpal ldan ma hā kā la dang*/ /'dod khams dbang phyug ma la 'bul/ /dam tshig dbang gis bzhes nas kyang*/ /bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod/ /oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya/ ma hā kā lī de wī ye/ gu h+ya ā laṃ kṛ ta pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ myos byed stong gi bcud bsdus pa/ /lcags kyu lnga dang yang dag ldan/ /bdud rtsi lnga dang rab sbyar te/ /ye shes lnga yis byin rlabs pa/ kha dog dri ro nus par ldan/ /dngos grub pad+mo 'byung ba'i gnas/ /mkha' 'gro ngang pa 'du ba'i gzhi/ /gsang ba bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'di/ /dpal ldan ma hā kā la dang*/ /'dod khams dbang phyug ma la 'bul/ /dam tshig dbang gis bzhes nas kyang*/ /bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod/ /oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya (《 zha 》《 lu 》 ye ) / ma hā kā lī de wī ye/ gu h+ya a mṛ ta sa mu dra pū dzi te ā hūm̐/ /dgra bgegs rnams kyi sha dang khrag /sgron ma lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga/ /bza' dang btung ba sna tshogs bcas/ /sna tshogs rgyan gyis mdzes byas pa/ /ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgya yis/ /bzhed rgu 'byung ba'i rgya mtshor ni/ /mngon par byin gyis brlabs nas kyang*/ /dam tshig bzhin du bdag 'bul gyis/ /thugs dam bzhin du bzhes mdzod la/ /dam bcas bzhin du rjes dgongs nas/ /rnal 'byor bdag gis bcol pa yi/ /las rnams thams cad grub par mdzod/ /oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya/ ma hā kā wī de wī ye/ ma hā pañtsa maṃ sa/ ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta ba lin+ta pū dzi tai āḥhūm̐/ rdo rje rgyal po rab khros pa'i/ khro bo'i khro bo mnyes byed pa// gsang ba'i mchod gtor rim pa 'di/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa 'phags pas sbyar//

// ༄༅/ /mgon po'i bstod pa (《 zha 》+ gang thugs ma ) bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ na ma ma hā kā lā ya/ hūm̐ gang gi thugs ni dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*/ /rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /sna tshogs sprul pas 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa/ /dpal chen gtum po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ khyod sku lhun po lta bur rab brjid cing*/ /mi 'gyur nam mkha'i mdangs ltar rab tu mdzes/ /chos kun de bzhin nyid du gcig pa'i dbu/ / bden gnyis zab mo'i don mtshon phyag dang zhabs/ /skyon drug gcod cing bdud sde'i dpung 'joms phyir/ /g.yas pa'i phyag gi gri gug thugs kar 'dzin | | 'dod khro rmongs spangs g.yon pa'i phyag gis ni/ /gdug pa'i khrag gis bkang ba'i thod pa 'dzin/ /chos sgra chen pos bdud kyi klad 'gems phyir// rnam 'phrul gaṇ+ḍi phyag gi dbus na bsnams/ /de bzhin gshegs pa lnga ni rnam dag pas/ /mi mgo skam po lnga yi dbu rgyan can/ /ā li kā li lnga bcu dag pa'i phyir | | gdug pa'i mgo rlon lnga bcu'i do shal 'dzin/ /gzung 'dzin rab spangs stag gi sham thabs can/ /klu chen dbang du bsdus pas sbrul gyis brgyan | | rin chen rus pa'i rgyan gyis rab tu sgeg /bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms pas dpa'/ khro gnyer mche ba rab gtsigs mi sdug pa/ /sna tshogs sprul pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gang gis gsung ni nam mkha'i mthas gtugs par/ /ha ha hi hi sogs pas rab tu bzhad/ /hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa la sogs drag shul sgras/ /bdud dang log 'dren tshogs rnams skrag par mdzad// dpa' bo gsung gi nga ro 'brug stong sgra/ /shin tu 'jigs rung sgrogs pa de la 'dud | khyod kyi thugs ni spros las rnam grol yang*/ /snying rje'i dbang gis 'gro ba'i yid la 'jug /skad cig gcig gis khams gsum ma lus pa/ /bza' bar nus pa'i rngam pa mchog dang ldan/ /de lta'i sprul pa sna tshogs rab ston yang

| | rang bzhin chos sku nyer zhi'i thugs la 'dud/ /dpa' bo khyod kyis thub pa'i bstan pa mchog /rab tu bskyang phyir log 'dren 'dul ba dang*/ / gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i sgor zhugs pa'i/ /lam la gnas pa'i rdo rje 'dzin pa skyongs/ /bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyi/ /rmi lam ltas sdig skal ba ngan pa dang*/ /nad dang gdon dang dus min 'chi la sogs/ /mi mthun phyogs rnams zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ /bdag dang gzhan la phan par gang sems pa/ /de dag kun gyi tshe dang bsod nams dang*/ /'khor dang longs spyod mthu dang dbang phyug kun/ /rtag tu mi nyams rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ /lha dang mi dang klu dang gnod sbyin sogs/ /'gro ba kun gyi gdug pa'i sems zhi nas | | thams cad bdag gi dbang du gyur nas kyang*/ /theg mchog ston pa'i snod du 'gyur bar mdzod/ /gang zhig zhi bas gdul bar mi nus pa/ /gdug cing gtum pa'i sems dang rab ldan pas/ /bla ma dam pa'i sku la bsdau ba dang*// sems can la 'tshe thub pa'i bstan la gnod/ /rnal 'byor rdo rje 'dzin pa bdag cag gi /sgrub la bar du gcod par byed pa yi/ /gdon dang log par 'dren pa'i tshogs kun la/ /gtum po khyod kyis mngon spyod las kyis ni/ / bskrad gzir bcing zhing rengs par byed pa dang*/ /rmugs shing dran pa rab tu nyams pa dang*/ /de yi lus ngag yid kyi rdzu 'phrul dang*/ /mthu dang longs spyod dbang phyug tshogs rnams kun/ /skad cig gis ni thams cad rab nyams nas// 'du ba rnam bzhi'i nad kyis gzir nas kyang*/ kha nas khong khrag dron mo rab skyugs nas/ /da lta nyid du gsad cing bsgral bar gyis/ /bdag gi bsgo ba'i tshig 'di ma bsgrubs na/ /sngon tshe bde bar gshegs pa'i spyan snga ru/ /thub pa'i bstan pa bsrung bar khas blangs pa/ /dam ∶ bcas tsam (《 zha 》 bca' nyams ) gyur de slad ma g.yel cig /de ltar bstod cing bskul ba'i tshig 'di yang*/

/bstan pa dri med mchog la rab dad cing*/ /gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i sgor zhugs pa'i | | rdo rje 'dzin pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal/ /skal ba bzang pos rab sbyar 'bad pa las/ /thob pa'i dge ba dri med de yis bdag /ji srid byang chub snying po mchis kyi bar/ /dpal chen rdo rje nag po khyod kyis ni/ /lam gyi bar du gcod pa kun bsal nas/ /bdud sde dpung bcas ma lus zil mnan te/ /sku gsum ye shes lnga yis bdag nyid can/ /bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par shog | lcags pho khyi'i lo rgyal gyi zla ba la mi nyag gi yul byang ngos su sbyar ba'o || || ༄༅/ /lcam dral gyi gtor chog bzhugs/ / ༄༅ / /oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ /bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / dpal rdo rje nag po chen po dang*/ dpal ldan lha mo'i mchod gtor byed par 'dod pas/ sha la sogs pas brgyan pa'i gtor ma legs par bshams nas/ rang yi dam gyi lha'i nga rgyal brtan po dang ldan pas/ gtor ma la lag pa g.yon pa bstan te/ oṃ zhes brjod pas gtor ma mi dmigs te stong par bsam/ g.yas pa bstan te/ āḥzhes brjod pas thod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba dpral ba rang la bstan par gyur par bsam/ gnyis ka bstan nas hūm̐ zhes brjod pas dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag dang sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas gang bar bsam/ bya khyung gi phyag rgya bstan nas ho zhes brjod pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur par bsams (《 zha 》《 lu 》+ la ) / oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes yang yang brjod cing byin gyis brlab/ de nas mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su dgra bgegs thams cad mnan pa'i steng du pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dbus su hūm̐ mthing nag (《 lu 》+ gcig ) bsam/ de las 'od zer phar 'phros pas dgra bgegs thams cad tshar gcad/ slar tshur 'dus nas | yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje nag po chen po cher 'bar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas pas gri gug dang*/ g.yon pas gdug pa'i khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/

phyag gnyis kyis gaṇ+ḍi bsnams pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang sbrul gyi rgyan gyis brgyan pa | stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can/ dar sna tshogs kyi cod pan dang lhab lhub kyi klubs pa/ mi'u thung gel pa'i 'dug stangs kyis ro'i steng na bzhugs pa | g.yas na bya nag g.yon na khyi nag rgyab na lcags (《 zha 》 lce ) spyang*/ mdun na mi nag steng na nam mkha'i lding gi sprul pa'i pho nya 'phro ba/ mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsam/ de'i g.yon du trag las e ka dza ṭī sku mdog sngon mo/ zhal gcig (《 lu 》+ ma ) phyag gnyis ma/ phyag gnyis kyis thugs kar bum pa 'dzin pa/ dar dkar gyi na bzas stod g.yogs pa/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can/ ral pa'i lan bu gcig tu gyur nas g.yon du 'phyang ba/ khro mo'i rnam pa can du bsam/ de'i lto ba yangs pa'i nang du trag las khrag gi rgya mtsho'i dbus su bh+yo las dpal ldan lha mo 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma/ bong bu la zhon pa zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ phyag g.yas kyi dang po na ral gri/ gnyis pa na thod pa khrag gis bkang ba | g.yon gyi dang po na mdung*/ gnyis pa na rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal dang rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa | glang po che'i ko bas stod g.yogs shing*/ ba lang gi ko bas smad g.yogs pa | re lde'i sham thabs can/ sbrul gyi ska rags bcings pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing mi ro rengs pa khar bcugs nas mche ba gtsigs pa/ snyan g.yas pa la dug sbrul dang*/ g.yon pa la seng ges brgyan pa/ sku la khrag gi thig le dang zhag gi zo ris dang*/ thal chen gyi tshom bu bkod pa/ shin tu rid pa lte ba'i thad ka nas nyi zla 'char zhing ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsam

| de nas mgon po dang lha mo gnyis ka'i dpral ba dang*/ mgrin pa dang*/ snying gar oṃ āḥhūm̐ bsam/ de nas rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros pas 'og min na rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs ka nas mgon po dang rang bzhin gyi gnas nas lha mo spyan drang bar bsam zhing*/ mgon po 'dir gshegs gdan las bzhengs | | da lta snyigs ma lnga yi dus/ /gshegs shing bzhugs pa'i gnas ngan yang | | shākya'i bstan pa bsrung ba dang*/ /bdag cag rnams la phan gdags phyir | | gnas 'di nyid du gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya/ ma hā kā lī de wī/ e h+ye hi zhes brjod pas mdun du spyan drangs/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la/ dzaḥ hūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ zhes pas ye shes kyi mgon po dam tshig gi mgon po la bstim/ oṃ ma hā kā lī de wī dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥzhes brjod pas ye shes kyi lha mo dam tshig gi lha mo la bstim | pad+ma ka ma la s+t+wam̐ zhes brjod pas pad+ma'i gdan 'bul/ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā | zhes brjod pas mchod yon 'bul/ de bzhin du pād+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes pas zhabs bsil/ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ gis me tog badz+ra dhu pe āḥhūm̐ gis bdug spos | badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐ gis mar me/ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐ gis dri/ badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐ gis zhal zas rnams so so la 'bul/ de nas chos skyong gi dam tshig g-i phyag rgya byas la/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya sa ma ya smā ra sa ma ya ma ti kra ma sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu zhes pa dang*/ lha mo'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya byas la/ ma hā kā lī de wī sa ma ya smā ra sa ma ya ma ti kra ma sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu zhes brjod nas thun mong du dam tshig gi rim pa las mi 'da' bar dpal rdo rje nag po chen po dang*/ dpal lha mo nag mo chen mo dam tshig srungs shig rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar dam tshig srungs la/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung zhing rgyas par

∶ byed pa dang (《 lu 》 mdzod ) / bdag cag la sdang bar byed pa'i dgra dang*/ gnod par byed pa'i bgegs thams cad thal ba rdul du brlag pa dang*/ phyi nang gi bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi ba dang*/ bsam pa thams cad chos bzhin du 'grub pa dang*/ tshe dang dpal dang 'byor pa thams cad rgyas par mdzod cig ces dam la bzhag go /de nas dpal mgon po dang*/ lha mo gnyis kyi zhal nas 'od kyi sbu gu byung nas/ gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye ba'i phyag rgya byas la/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ uṅga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ṇai daṃ ba liṃ te swāhā zhes pa gsum mam lan bdun gyis mgon po la 'bul | oṃ ma hā kā li de wī ye/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta la sogs pa gsum mam bdun gyis lha mo la dbul lo/ /de nas/ hūm̐ srin po'i gzugs kyis gdug pa can (《 zha 》 'dul ) / /tshar gcod byang chub sems dpa' ste/ /grong khyer sum brtsegs 'jig byed pa/ /gtum po khyod la bdag bstod do/ /mdog nag gzugs thung gzi brjid che/ /gdug pa tshar gcod gri gug g.yas/ /g.yon na gdug pa'i khrag bkang snod/ /thod phreng can la bdag bstod do/ khros pas zhabs brdabs sa gzhi g.yo/ /'jigs pa'i gad mos ri rab bsgyail/ /dam tshig nyams pa'i snying 'byin pa/ /dam tshig can la bdag bstod do/ /zhes pas bstod do/ /hūm̐ dpal ldan mgon po ma hā kā lā ya/ /lha chen dpal 'bar nag po mthu bo che/ /ma hā de wa'i sras po drag shul can/ /tshogs bdag chen po ma hā kā lā ya/ /'jigs byed chen po ma hā kā lā ya/ /legs ldan nag po grong khyer sum brtsegs dgra/ /bstan pa yongs kyi srung ma nag po che/ /chos 'khor yongs kyi srog shing nag po che/ /dam tshig can gyi dgra bla nag po che/ (《 lu 》+ dam nyams rnams kyi snying 'byin nag po che/ ) /'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig/sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig

/'dzam bu ti pa'i zhal zas 'di bzhes shig /dza gad dpa' bo sman dang phud kyi ∶ mchod pa (《 zha 》 gtor ma ) 'di bzhes shig /sngar bcol las kyi gtang rag gnyen por 'bul/ /da bcol las kyi gsal 'debs gnyen por bzhes/ /'khor rnams srung zhing rkyen rnams bzlog pa dang*/ /sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs la sogs/ /bdud dang bar du gcod pa rnam mang po/ /thams cad rdul phran bzhin du brlag par mdzod | | bstan pa bsrung ba'i las 'di myur du sgrubs/ /zhes pas chos skyong la gtor ma bstabs/ phrin las gzhol lo/ /de nas lha mo la bstod pa bya ste/ hūm̐ bh+yo/ gang gi sku gsung thugs kyi mthus/ /'dod pa'i khams kun zil mnan nas | | 'dod pa'i khams la dbang sgyur ba/ /'dod khams dbang phyug ma la 'dud | | ces pas bstod nas/ dpal ldan 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma// 'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig /ces pa la sogs pas gtor ma bstabs/ phrin las gzhol lo/ /de nas/ dpal ldan mgon po ma hā kā lā dang*/ /dpal ldan lha mo mi pham srid gsum bdag /lcam dral khyed kyi bka' las mi 'da' ba'i/ /dur khrod bdag po zhing skyong 'khor dang bcas/ / snang srid lha srin sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas/ /dregs pa pho rgyud mo rgyud 'khor dang bcas/ (《 lu 》+ mkha' lding la sogs gcan gzan 'khor dang bcas/ /pu tra la sogs las mkhan 'khor dang bcas/ /mi nag la sogs sprul pa 'khor dang bcas/ /'dir bzhugs gzhi bdag gnyan po 'khor dang bcas/ /srung ma rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams 'khor dang bcas/ /dam can mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams 'khor dang bcas/ ) /'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig /ces pa la sogs pas 'khor rnams la gtor ma bstabs/ phrin las gzhol/ de nas bzlas pa byed par 'dod pas/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas chos skyong gi thugs bskul bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/

zhes pa'i snying po'i sngags dang*/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya/ shā sa na u pa ha ri ṇi | e ṣa a pash+tsī ma kā lo/ a yaṃ i daṃ rat+na tra yā ya/ a pa kā ri ṇāṃ/ ya di pra ti dzñā/ sma ra si ta dā/ i daṃ duṣ+tāṃ/ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ma ra ma ra/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ dī na me ke na mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa hūm̐/ zhes pa'i gzungs kyi sngags ci nus par bzla'o/ /de bzhin du lha mo'i thugs bskul bar bsams la/ oṃ ro ru ro ru bi tiṣ+ṭha ba dh+wat+si ka ma la rāk+ṣa sī hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ zhes pa'i sngags ci nus bzla'o/ /de nas sngar bzhin du me tog la sogs pas mchod cing gang shes pas bstod la/ gsol ba btab nas bzod par gsol te | oṃ shrī ma hā kā la badz+ra muḥm hā kā lī de wī badz+ra muḥzhes pas ye shes pa gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa bdag la bsdu'o/ /bris sku la sogs pa'i rten yod na gshegs su gsol mi dgos so/ /de nas chos skyong gi gzungs ring bzlas shing gtor ma la dpal 'bar btsugs la gtang ngo*/ /tshul 'dis rtag tu gtor ma btang na/ byang chub thob kyi bar du srung ba dang*/ 'dod pa'i don sgrub pa dang*/ bgegs dang log par 'dren pa 'joms par 'gyur ro/ /dpal nag po chen po lcam dral gyi

∶ gtor ma'i (《 zha 》 mchod gtor gyi ) cho ga bla ma'i phyag len bzhin 'phags pas bris nas jim gyin la phul ba'o// //'di'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ bram ze mchog sred/ bde ba'i rdo rje/ shrad+dhā ka ra warma | jo bo rin chen bzang po/ bla ma brag steng pa/ bla ma mal lo tsā ba bla ma sa skya pa yab sras rnams so/ /ma tshang med cing bsgrub par sla ba yi/ /cho ga'i rim pa 'di ni bdag gis bsdebs/ /spros la dga' bas rgyas pa gzhan du btsal/ / 'di tsam gyis kyang skabs kyi don 'grub 'gyur// // ༄༅/ /bshags pa bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral (《 zha 》+ bran g.yog ) 'khor dang bcas pa la zhu zhing gsol ba ni/ che ge mo zhes bgyi ba bdag las nyon mongs pa dang*/ mi shes pa dang*/ bag med pa dang*/ ma gus pa dang*/ snyom las kyi dbang du gyur pas rang bzhin dang bcas pa'i kha na ma tho ba bgyis pa dang*/ dam tshig dang mi ldan pa dang*/ dam tshig ma dag pa dang*/ tshogs 'dres pa dang*/ spyod yul gcig par gyur pa dang*/ bsnyen pa dang*/ sgrub pa la ma brtson pa dang*/ srung ma khyad par can khyed rnams dus dus su ma mchod cing ma gsol ba'i dbang gis/ sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig chags nyams su gyur pa dang*/ khyed rnams kyi thugs dang 'gal bar gyur pa thams cad spros med rnam par mi rtaug pa'i ngang nas/ thugs rje dang mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug dam pa khyed rnams la mthol lo bshags so/ /bzod par gsol lo/ /mkha' la sprin dengs pa'am/ rgya mtsho la rlabs zhi ba ltar/ nongs par spyad pa dang*/ de'i 'bras bu thams cad med par gyur cig zhi bar gyur cig rab tu zhi bar gyur cig sngags dang | phyag rgya dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma (《 zha 》+ dar sna tshogs kyi rgyan pa ) 'di dang*/ rta mchog rgyan gyis brgyan pa 'di dang*/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo dam pa dang bcas pa'i mchod pa 'dis/

dpal mgon khyad par can khyed rnams kyi thugs dam skong bar gyur cig bzhed pa grub par gyur cig re ba rdzogs par gyur cig de ltar gyur nas kyang*/ bdag gi sngon gyi las las gyur pa dang*/ 'phral gyi rkyen las gyur pa'i nad dang*/ bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ dgra dang bgegs dang log par 'dren pa thams cad bzlog tu gsol/ tshe dang dpal dang longs spyod rgyas pa dang*/ dbang phyug phun sum tshogs par mdzad du gsol/ 'jig rten dang | 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub pa ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ khyed thugs gsang ba dam pa'i mdzod/ /dges pa chen po'i sgo phye nas/ /dngos grub phrin las bdud rtsi yi/ /rgyun gyis bdag rgyud gtams par mdzod/ / dpal mgon po lcam dral gyi bshags pa 'phags pas sbyar ba'o// // ༄༅/ /gdong bzhi pa'i bstod pa bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /dpal gdong bzhi pa'i mgon po la bstod pa zhes bya ba/ rdo rje 'dzin pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas thams cad gcig bsdus pa/ /bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal te/ /bstan pa bsrung pa'i las brtson pa/ /nag po chen por bstod par bgyi/ /bstan pa spel zhing bsrung ba'i phyir/ /rdo rje 'chang bas byin brlabs nas/ /nyid kyi bka' yis gnyer bsgos pa/ /nag po chen po khyod la bstod/ /gnas rnams kun la rnam rol yang*/ /nges pa bzhin du gru 'dzin dang*/ /siṅga li dang ti se ru/ /rnam par gnas pa khyod la bstod/ khyod ni gang du 'khod gyur pa/ /dur khrod rol pa'i gzhal yas te/ /de dbus pad+ma nyi ma la | | bsgy-ings te bzhugs pa khyod la bstod/ /zhal bzhi pa dang phyag bzhi pa/ / zhabs gnyis gar gyi stabs kyis bzhugs/ /sku mdog nag po 'bar chen po/ / lhun po ltar brjid khyod la bstod/ /rtsa zhal nag po gdangs pa'i zhal/ / g.yas zhal dkar po khro zhing 'dzum/ /g.yon pa dmar zhing rgya cher bzhad/ / steng zhal dud kha khro gnyer gdong*/ /zhal re'ang dmar la zlum pa dang*/

/glog ltar 'khyug pa'i spyan gsum ldan/ /skra dang sma ra ser zhing 'bar/ /mche ba gtsigs pa khyod la bstod/ /phyag g.yas dang pos gri gug dang*/ /g.yon gyi dang pos thod khrag 'dzin/ /g.yas gnyis ral gri cig shos kyis/ /chang gi bum pa 'dzin la bstod/ /dung chen po dang lto 'gro dang*/ /stag dang dar gyi lhab lhub dang*/ khrag dang zhag gi thig le yi/ /rgyan gyis sgeg pa khyod la bstod/ /mi mgo skam po'i cod pan dang*/ /rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ /sbrul dang rgyu ma rlon pa yi/ /tshangs skud 'chang ba khyod la bstod/ /nyi ma'i 'od ltar cher gsal zhing | | dus mtha'i me ltar rab gdung ba'i/ /me lce'i phreng bas gdug pa kun// rnam par sreg pa khyod la bstod/ /ha ha'i gad mo rgya cher bzhad/ /hūm̐ hūm̐ 'brug gi sgra ltar sgrogs/ /k+ṣiṃ k+ṣiṃ rnam par bsgy-ings pa'i sgras/ /sa gsum g.yo bar mdzad la bstod/ khyod thugs rdo rje 'dzin pa la/ /shin tu dad pas nyer zhi yang | | de yi bstan la gnod byed la/ khro zhing 'khrugs pa khyod la bstod/ /nye bar zhi la nyer gzhol yang*/ /dam tshig sdom pas nyer mdzes shing*/ /bsgrub la brtson pa'i sgrub po la/ /rjes su chags pa khyod la bstod/ /'dod pa'i bde ba thams cad dang*/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi bde ba la/ /bdag nyid dgyes rgur rnam rol cing*/ /'phags pa mchod mdzad khyod la bstod/ khyod dang rjes mtshungs dpa' mo ni/ /dpal gyis khyod la nyer mchod cing*/ /mthun par bstan pa rjes bsrungs pas/ /bskor ba khyod la bdag bstod do/ /g.yas na g.yung mo nag mo dang | | de bzhin g.yon na gtum mo ljang*/ /mdun na srin mo nag mo dang*/ / rgyab na siṅga lī gnas sngo/ /thams cad mdzes shing grims pa'i lus/ /sna tshogs rgyan gyis rab sgeg cing*/ khro zhing 'dzum la stegs (《 zha 》 sgeg ) chos can// rngam zhing dgod la 'jigs rung ma/ /g.yas pa gri gug 'dzin pa yis/ /phyogs bcur gdug can rnam par bsdigs/

/g.yon pa khrag zhag gis gang ba'i/ / thod pa 'dzin pa'i lag pa yis/ /yab la 'khril zhing rnam par stobs/ /de bzhin zhal bzhi'i spyod yul te/ /dgyes pa'i tshe na sbyor ba yis/ /mgon po shin tu tshim byed cing*/ /las kyi tshe na mngon spyod kyis/ /dgra bgegs rnam par sgrol bar byed/ /lhun po gling bzhis bskor 'dra ba'i/ /yab yum rnams la gus pas bstod/ khyod kyi bka' nyan pho nya'i tshogs/ kha dog ldan zhing 'od dang ldan | | mthu chen rdzu 'phrul chen po yi/ /shugs kyis phyogs bcur rnam par rgyug | la la mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin/ kha cig snyim par dgra bo yi/ khrag dang nang khraul gyis bkang nas/ /za bzhin du ni rnam par rgyu/ /glog ltar myur zhing 'brug ltar sgrogs/ /rdo rje lta bur thogs med pas/ khyod kyi bka' stsal sgrub byed pa/ /'khor dang bcas la bstod par bgyi/ /de ltar yab dang yum rnams dang | | 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyis/ /sngon tshe thub pa'i spyan snga ru/ / de yis ji ltar bsgos pa dang*/ /nyid kyi ji ltar dam bcas dang*/ khyod kyi 'khor gyis khyod las (《 lu 》 la ) ni/ /ji ltar bsgo ba thob pa yi/ /dam tshig nye bar dgongs mdzod la/ /thub pa'i bstan pa bsrung ba dang*/ /bstan la gnod byed gdul ba dang*/ /bstan pa rjes su sgrub byed pa/ /thams cad nye bar skyong bar mdzod/ /bza' ba sna tshogs bca' bar ldan/ /sran chan sna tshogs 'bras bur bcas/ /sha chen sna tshogs nya shar bcas/ khrag chen zhag dang khrag gzhan bcas | | zan dron me tog rnying pa dang*/ /spos dang chang phud mar me dang*/ /sna tshogs dar sogs kyis klubs pa'i/ /gtor ma 'di ni ting 'dzin dang*/ / sngags kyi rgya cher byin brlabs nas/ /dang ba'i sems kyis bdag 'bul gyis | | gsol cig gsol cig bza' ba'i tshogs/ /'chos shig 'chos shig bca' ba'i tshogs/ /'thung shig 'thung shig btung ba'i tshogs/ /snoms shig snoms shig dri dang spos/

/bzhes shig bzhes shig mchod pa'i tshogs/ /tshim par rol nas bdag la dgongs/ /bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa dang*/ /bdag la gnod par byed pa yi/ /sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs/ /mngon spyod las kyis tshar chod la/ /de yi phun tshogs gang yin pa/ /de kun bdag gi 'byor bar mdzod/ /slan chad gnod byed thams cad kyis/ /glags mi rnyed par srung du gsol/ /gzhan yang nad dang bar chad kun/ /shin tu nye bar zhi ba dang | | tshe dang longs spyod dpal 'byor rnams/ /kun nas rab tu rgyas pa dang | | mi dang mi min ma lus pa/ /bdag gi dbang du bsdu ba dang*/ /gzhan yang ji ltar gang 'dod pa/ /de kun ji bzhin 'grub par mdzod/ /de ltar dpal gdong bzhi pa la bstod cing bskul ba'i rab tu byed pa 'di ni/ dge slong 'phags pa la de nyid kyi slob ma rig pa'i nor 'chang ba/ ting 'dzin shes rab ces bya bas yang nas yang du gsol ba btab pa'i don du/ chu mo bya'i lo gdu bu'i zla ba'i tshes gcig la/ shing kun tu sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni a tsa ra zhes bya ba'o || || ༄༅/ /dzam+bha la ser po'i sgrub thabs bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo | | 'phags pa dzam+bha la bsgom par 'dod pas/ stan bde ba la bsdad/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba bya/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ gnas skabs su bdag dang gzhan gyi dbul ba dang rgud pa thams cad bsal nas 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa thob par bya/ de'i don du dzam+bha la bsgom par bya snyam du byang chub kyi sems bsgom/ de nas rang gi snying ga'i nang du zla ba'i steng du dzam̐ gser gyi mdog can zhig bsams pa las 'od 'phros pas rang gi sdig pa dang*/ sgrib pa dang*/ dbul ba dang*/ rgud pa bsal/ yang ba spu'i bu ga nas 'od 'phros pas sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang*/ sgrib pa sbyangs/ dbul ba dang rgud pa bsal/

sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi dpal 'byor bsdus pa rang la thim pas/ rang nyid rin po che'i gter sna tshogs kyis gang ba'i bum pa'i tshogs kyis bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du pad+ma dang*/ zla ba la bzhugs pa'i dzam+bha la gser btso ma lta bu'i zhabs g.yas cung zad brkyang zhing*/ g.yon bskum pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ spyan gsum pa/ rab tu brjid cing sku sha rgyas pa/ phyag g.yas pa mchog sbyin pas bi dza pū ra'i shing tog 'dzin shing*/ g.yon pas rin po che sna tshogs kyi rgyun skyugs pa'i ne'u le 'dzin pa | rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan zhing*/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' mnabs pa/ spyi bor sangs rgyas rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur rgyan par bsam | de'i thugs ka'i dzam̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ ri rab kyi steng nas dzam+bha la spyan drang*/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥs rang la gnyis su med par bstim/ rang gi 'khor du 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i nor lha sprin 'thibs pa bzhin du bzhugs pas rin po che dang*/ zas nor gyi char 'bebs pa bsams la/ sems mnyam par bzhag go /sngags zlo bar 'dod na/ rang gi snying ga'i dzam̐ gyi mtha' mar sngags kyi phreng bas 'khor ba las 'od 'phros pas 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i nor gyi lha thams cad dbang du bsdus nas/ de dag gis bdag la rin po che dang zas nor gyi char phab par bsam zhing*/ oṃ dzam+bha la dza len+d+rā ya swāhā/ zhes ci nus pa bzla'o/ /chu sbyin gtong bar 'dod na/ rin po che'i sder gyi nang du rin po che las bzhengs pa'i dzam+bha la bzhugs su bcug pa'am | bzhugs par mos la bdag bskyed bzhin bskyed nas/ rin po che'i bum pa chus bkang la/ /a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa'i nang du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ las bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis gang ba bskyed la/

rang gi lag pa g.yas pa'i mthil du yi ge dzam̐ bskyed pa las | bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun byung bas/ dzam+bha la la mchod par bsam zhing*/ lag pa g.yas pa'i khyor mos chu phul/ oṃ dzam+bha la dza len+d+rā ya swāhā/ zhes ci rigs pa bzlas pa'i mthar/ oṃ swā hā/ zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis phul bas bcom ldan 'das mnyes nas bdag la 'dod rgu'i dngos grub gnang bar bsams la/ oṃ dzam+bha la dza len+d+rā ya ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ dī pe/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐ zhes pas mchod la/ bcom ldan gang zhig rgyal ba thams cad kyi/ /nam mkha' mdzod kyi ting 'dzin las 'phrul bas/ /gdul bya rnams la dpal 'byor kun stsol ba/ /rmugs 'dzin chu dbang khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas bstod nas | sku gzugs med na/ badz+ra muḥs gshegs su gsol/ yod na bsdus la chu sa gtsang ma'am/ chu ra la sogs par dor ro/ /chu sbyin gyi cho ga'o/ / 'phags pa dzam+bha la'i sgrub thabs mdor bsdus pa 'di ni kim kaṃ nu zhes bya bas bskul ba'i don 'phags pas sa mo yos bu'i lo ston zla 'bring po'i tshes bcu dgu la dpal sa skyar sbyar ba'o// // ༄༅/ /phyogs bzhi'i gtor ma bzhugs so/ / ༄༅/ /dpal rdo rje 'dzin pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shar phyogs su lha thams cad pa'i gtor ma bya ba'i rim pa ni/ dri yi dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa/ / me tog dkar gsum mchod byas te/ /dri dang 'bras chan ka ra zho/ /sbrang rtsi mngar ldan shar sgor sbyin/ /tshom bu'am thig le nyi shu rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bkod la/ rang nyid phyag na rdo rje la sogs pa'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas bzlas pa ci rigs pa bya ste/ mchod pa bsang zhing byin gyis brlabs nas/ skad cig ma'i ting nge 'dzin gyis dkyil 'khor dang mtshan ma rnams gzhal yas khang dang*/ lha nyi shu rtsa gsum du bskyed la/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings te/ rgyab dang rgyab tu sbyar bar bya/ /pa gdugs dang ni pad+ma sbrel/

/ro tsa na dang ka ro brkyang*/ /dkar po bkug nas 'dren pa ni/ /lha dang lha min grub pa dgug/oṃ ba ta lī ma hā ba ta lī hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ dzaḥswā hā/ oṃ a/ rgyu ba mo dang rgyu chen mo/ /de bzhin yi dwags rgyu ba mo/ /nyi ma zla ba dngos grub sbyin/ /rta rgyal mo dang zla rgyal mo/ /lha mo u ma gaṅgā mo/ /gzugs mdzes skar ma 'dus pa dang*/ /gza' tshogs kun dang tshogs kyi gtso/ /kā rti kā dang dpal lha mo/ /lha mo ri bong can 'dzin ma/ a ga la dang ut+pa la/ /lha min lha yi rgyal po rnams/ /sbaus mo dang ni sbos chen mo/ /mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /dngos grub don du bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ hūm̐ he ho ā kar+ṣa ya ā kar+ṣa ya/ sa ma ya dī pe hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa dzaḥswā hā/ zhes pa lan gsum gyis spyan drangs nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥs gnyis su med par bstim/ pad+ma ka mā lā ya s+t+waṃ gyis so so la gdan phul nas/ mchod pa dang gtor ma dbul bar bya ste/ so so'i phyag rgya dang ting nge 'dzin dang ldan pas/ dri med yid du 'ong ba yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod yon 'di/ /rgyu ba mo la dbul bar bgyi/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /oṃ ba ta lī ye gṛh+ṇai daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ de bzhin du me tog dang*/ spos dang*/ dri dang*/ mar me dang*/ zhal zas dang*/ rol mo dang*/ gdugs dang*/ rgyal mtshan dang*/ ba dan rnams la sbyar te dbul bar bya'o/ /de nas sngar gyi phyag rgya las/ sdigs mdzub bkrol nas se gol brdab cing*/ gtor ma dbul bar bsams nas/ oṃ bak+ṣa ya bak+ṣa ya sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha dzaḥdz+rum̐ hūm̐ phrum̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum mam bdun gyis gtor ma dbul lo/ /de bzhin du rgyu ba chen po la dbul bar bgyi zhes pa dang*/ oṃ ma hā ba

∶ tā lī (《 zha 》 ha nī ) ye gṛh+ṇai daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ zhes pa la sogs pa dang*/ yi dwags rgyu ba mo la dbul/ /oṃ pre ta ba ta lī ye gṛh+ṇai daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ zhes pa la sogs pa dang*/ nyi ma la ni dbul bar bgyi/ /oṃ sūr+yā ya (《 zha 》 ye ) gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ zhes pa la sogs pa dang*/ zla ba la ni dbul bar bgyi | | oṃ tsan+d+rā ya gṛh+ṇai daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ zhes pa la sogs pa dang*/ dngos grub sbyin la dbul bar bgyi/ /oṃ sid+dhi dāt+tā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ zhes pa la sogs pa dang*/ rta rgyal mo la dbul bar bgyi/ /oṃ a shwa rā dzñi ye gṛh+ṇai daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ zhes pa la sogs pa dang*/ zla rgyal mo la dbul bar bgyi/ /oṃ sau ma rādzñī ye gṛh+ṇai daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ zhes pa la sogs pa dang*/ u ma la ni dbul bar bgyi/ / oṃ u ma de wī ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ zhes pa la sogs pa dang*/ gaṅgā'i lha mo nyid la dbul/ /oṃ gaṅgāde w+yai gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ zhes pa la sogs pa dang*/ gzugs mdzes pa la dbul bar bgyi/ /oṃ su rū pī ye gṛh+ṇai daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ zhes pa la sogs pa dang*/ skar ma'i tshogs la dbul bar bgyi/ /oṃ tā rā yai saṃ ghā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ zhes pa la sogs pa dang*/ gza' yi tshogs la dbul bar bgyi/ /oṃ gra ha na ∶ saṃ ghā ya (《 zha 》 sarba ye ) gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ zhes pa la sogs pa dang*/ tshogs kyi gtso bo nyid la dbul/ /oṃ ga ṇa pa ta ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ zhes pa la sogs pa dang*/ kārti kā la dbul bar bgyi/ /oṃ kārti kā ya gṛh+ṇai daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ zhes pa la sogs pa dang*/ dpal ldan ma la dbul bar bgyi/ /oṃ shri yai gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ zhes pa la sogs pa dang*/ lha mo ri bong can la dbul/ /oṃ sha shī de byai gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ zhes pa la sogs pa dang | a ga lā la dbul bar bgyi/

/oṃ a ga lā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ zhes pa la sogs pa dang*/ nye ba'i a ga lā la dbul/ /oṃ u pā ga lā ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swāhā/ zhes pa la sogs pa dang*/ lha yi gtso bo rnams la dbul/ /oṃ su ra rādzñī gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghāṃ swā hā/ zhes pa la sogs pa dang*/ lha min gtso bo rnams la dbul | | oṃ a su ra rādzñī gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ zhes pa la sogs pa dang*/ sbos mo la ni dbul bar bgyi/ /oṃ puk+ka sī ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swāhā/ zhes pa la sogs pa dang*/ nye ba'i sbos mo nyid la dbul/ /oṃ u pa puk+ka sī ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ zhes pa la sogs pa dang*/ de ltar mchod pa dang gtor mas mnyes par byas nas | mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la/ /zhes pa la sogs pa rnams kyis phrin las bcol la/ so so'i rgyud bskul nas dngos grub blang bar bya ba'i phyir du sngags kyi bzlas pa bya ste/ oṃ bā ta lī ye swā hā/ oṃ ma hā ba ta lī ye swā hā/ oṃ pre ta ba ta lī ye swā hā/ oṃ sūr+yā ya swā hā/ oṃ tsan+d+rā ya swā hā/ oṃ sid+dhi dāt+tā yai swā hā/ oṃ a shwa rādzñī ye swā hā/ oṃ sau ma rādzñī swā hā/ oṃ u ma de byai swā hā/ oṃ gaṃ ga de byai swā hā/ oṃ su rū s+yai swā hā/ oṃ tā rā saṃ ghā ya swā hā/ oṃ gra ha ṇa ∶ saṃ ghā ya (《 zha 》 sarba ye ) swā hā/ oṃ ga ṇa pa ta ye swā hā/ oṃ kārti kā yai swā hā/ oṃ shrī yai swā hā/ oṃ sha shā+-i de wī ye swā hā/ oṃ a ga lā ya swāhā/ oṃ u pa a ga lā ya swā hā/ oṃ su ra rādzñe swā hā/ oṃ a su ra ∶ rādzñe (《 zha 》 dzā ye ) swā hā/ oṃ puk+ka sī ye swā hā/ oṃ u pa puk+ka sī ye swā hā/ zhes bya ba'i sngags rnams re re la yang brgya rtsa brgyad la sogs pa bzla'o | | slar yang mchod de dngos grub blangs la bzod par gsol nas/ oṃ ba ta lī ye gats+tsha/ zhes kun la sbyar la gshegs su gsol lo/

/rim pa 'di nyid kyis thun gsum mam bzhi la sogs par btang ngo*/ /yongs su rdzogs pa dang las kyi rjes mi mngon par bsdu'o/ /shin tu bsdus te gtong bar 'dod na/ spyan drangs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa dang*/ sngags kyis spyan drangs pa'i mthar/ oṃ bhak+ṣa ya bhak+ṣa ya zhes bya ba'i sngags 'ba' zhig gis phul nas/ phrin las bcol la gshegs su gsol lo/ /rgyas pa dang bsdus pa gnyis char gyis phrin las bcol ba'i mthar chos kyi sbyin pa dang*/ bden pa'i stobs brjod par bya'o | | shar phyogs su bya ba lha thams cad pa'i gtor ma'i cho ga rdzogs so || || ༄༅/ /lho phyogs 'byung po'i gtor ma bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /dpal rdo rje 'dzin pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje stabs kyis lhor gnas te/ /tsan+dan dmar po la sogs pas/ /phyi rol dkyil 'khor gru gsum bya/ /der ni me tog dmar po dgram/ /nya skam dang ni sha skam dang*/ / sgog pa byi sku khrag gi snod/ /til gyi tsha mig (《 zha 》 ba'i ) khu ba rnams/ khyad par du ni bdud rtsi lnga/ /rnam pa sna tshogs bza' ba dang*/ /sran ma lnga dang sran chan gyis | | gang ba'i snod ni mdun du bzhag /tshom bu'am thig le bzhi bcu rtsa gcig dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bkod la/ rang nyid he ru ka la sogs pa'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas bzlas pa ci rigs par byas la/ mchod pa dang gtor ma byin gyis brlabs nas 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i phyag rgya dang*/ sngags 'di yis ni dgug par bya/ /oṃ ba ta lī ma hā ba ta lī hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ dzaḥswā hā/ oṃ shing gcig dang ni dur khrod dang*/ /ri dang brag dang phug gi sa/ /yul gyi 'dab dang lam gyi shing*/ khyad par du ni khyim stong dang*/ /stong dang thang dang sa steng dang*/ khyad par gdol pa'i khyim gnas pa/ /nag po drag po drag chen po/ /lhas byin mnyam du brten pa dang*/ /nag po gtsigs pa 'jigs byed pa/ /dga' ba las 'das bgegs rgyal po/ /rgyan byed ma dang drag mo dang*/

/'jigs ma lha mo dka' zlog mo/ /rgyal mo dang ni rnam rgyal mo/ /thub med gzhan gyis mi thub ma | | nag po bzang mo nag chen mo/ /nag sbom rnal 'byor ma dbang mo/ /zla mo drag mo sdang ba mo/ /'phyang ma sum cu'i dbang phyug ma/ /kaṃ po tsi dang mar me ma | | 'o byed grong gnas rnal 'byor ma/ /drag gzugs ma dang gzugs chen ma | | mche gtsigs ma dang thod can ma/ /thod pa'i phreng ba thod can ma/ kha ṭ+wāṃ can ma mthu chen ma/ /ral gri dgra sta'i lag can ma/ /rdo rje'i lag pa gzhu lag ma/ /mkha' 'gro lnga yi de nyid dang*/ /las kun rjes sgrub byed pa yi/ / sbyor ba'i dkyil 'khor rgyal chen mo/ /de bzhin rdo rje dbang phyug gtso/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku chen mo/ /rdul med sbyor ba skye med ma/ /rdo rje dbang phyug ma bka' yis/ /thams cad thams cad 'ong bar byos/ /oṃ kak+ka ka da na ba | ba ban+dha na/ kha kha kha da na/ sarba duṣ+tā ∶ nāṃ (《 zha 》 na ma ) / ha na ha na/ gha ta ya sarba bhu ta hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa dzaḥswā hā/ zhes bya ba gsum gyis spyan drangs dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥs gnyis su med par bstim la/ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ gyis so so la gdan phul nas/ so so la mchod pa dang*/ gtor ma dbul bar bya ste/ dri med yid du 'ong ba yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod yon 'di/ /drag po nag po nyid la dbul// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /oṃ kṛṣ+ṇa ru drā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ de bzhin du me tog dang*/ spos dang*/ dri dang*/ mar me dang*/ zhal zas dang*/ rol mo dang*/ gdugs dang*/ rgyal mtshan dang*/ ba dan rnams la sbyar te dbul bar bya'o/ khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi phyag rgya bcings te/ mdzub mo gnyis lu gu rgyud byas la/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭhā bhak+ṣa ya bhak+ṣa ya phaṭa dzaḥswā hā/ zhes pa gsum mam bdun gyis gtor ma dbul lo/ /de bzhin du/ drag chen mo la dbul bar bgyi | | oṃ ma hā ru drā yai gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghāṃ swā hā/

lhas byin mnyam du brten la dbul | | oṃ de wā dāt+ta sa mā shri ye gṛh+ṇai daṃ ar+ghāṃ swā hā/ nag po la ni dbul bar bgyi | | oṃ kṛṣ+ṇā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghāṃ swā hā/ gtsigs pa la ni dbul bar bgyi/ /oṃ a ka rā lā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghāṃ swā hā/ 'jigs byed la ni dbul bar bgyi/ /oṃ bi bhat+sā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghāṃ swā hā/ dga' ba las 'das nyid la dbul/ /oṃ nan+de tā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghāṃ swā hā/ bgegs rgyal po la dbul bar bgyi/ /oṃ bi na ya kā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghāṃ swā hā/ rgan byed ma la dbul bar bgyi/ /oṃ tsa muṇ+ḍī ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghāṃ swā hā/ drag po la ni dbul bar bgyi/ /oṃ gau rī ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghāṃ swāhā/ 'jigs ma la ni dbul bar bgyi/ /oṃ bi ba bhat+sā yai gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghāṃ? swā hā/ lha mo dka' zlog ma la dbul bar bgyi/ /oṃ u ma de wī tsa ma ta rā ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghāṃ swā hā | rgyal mo la ni dbul bar bgyi/ /oṃ dza yā yai gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghāṃ swā hā/ rnam rgyal mo la dbul bar bgyi/ /oṃ bi dza yāñtsai bā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghāṃ swāhā/ thub med la ni dbul bar bgyi/ /oṃ a dzī tā yai gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghāṃ swā hā/ gzhan gyis mi thub ma la dbul | | oṃ a pa rā dzī tā yai gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ nag mo bzang mo nyid la dbul | | oṃ bha dra kā lī ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghāṃ swā hā/ nag chen mo la dbul bar bgyi | | oṃ ma hā kā lī ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghāṃ swā hā/ nag sbom la ni dbul bar bgyi// oṃ s+thū la kā lī ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghāṃ swā hwā/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug mo la dbul/ /oṃ dzo ki nīn+d+rā yai gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghāṃ swā hā/ zla mo la ni dbul bar bgyi/ /oṃ tsan+d+rī ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ drag po la ni dbul bar bgyi/ oṃ gau rī ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghāṃ swā hā/ sdang mo la ni dbul bar bgyi/

/oṃ duṣ+tā yai gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swāhā/ 'phyang ma la ni dbul bar bgyi/ /oṃ lam+ba kī ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghāṃ swā hā/ sum cu'i dbang phyug ma la dbul | | oṃ triṃ sha ta shwa rī ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ kaṃ po tsi la dbul bar bgyi/ / oṃ kaṃ po tsī ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghāṃ swā hā/ mar me ma la dbul bar bgyi/ /oṃ dī pā yai gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghāṃ swā hā/ 'o byed ma la dbul bgyi/ /oṃ tsuṃ bi n+yā gra mā wa s+thī ta yo gi nī ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghāṃ swā hā/ drag gzugs ma la dbul bar bgyi/ /oṃ gau rī rū pi ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghāṃ swā hā/ gzugs can ma la dbul bar bgyi/ /oṃ ma hā rū pī ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghāṃ swā hā/ mche gtsigs ma la dbul bar bgyi/ /oṃ daṃṣ+tā (《 zha 》+ e ) ka rā lī (《 zha 》 - lī ) ye grih+ṇe daṃ ar+ghāṃ swā hā/ thod can ma la dbul bar bgyi/ /oṃ ka pā lī ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghāṃ swā hā/ thod pa'i phreng la dbul bar bgyi/ /oṃ ka pā li mā li nī ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ phreng ba can la dbul bar bgyi/ /oṃ mā le nī ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghāṃ swā hā/ kha ṭāṃ can ma nyid la dbul/ /oṃ kha ṭāṃ ga nī ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghāṃ swā hā/ mthu chen mo la dbul bar bgyi/ /oṃ ma hā dhi ka gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghāṃ swā hā/ ral gri'i lag can ma la dbul/ /oṃ khaḍ+ga hasti nī ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghāṃ swā hā/ dgra sta'i lag pa can la dbul/ /oṃ pa ra shu hasti nī ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghāṃ swā hā/ rdo rje'i lag can ma la dbul/ /oṃ badz+ra hasti nī ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghāṃ swā hā/ gzhu lag ma la dbul bar bgyi/ /oṃ dha nu hasti nī ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghāṃ swā hā/ zhes pa la sogs pa rnams kyis mchod do/ /de nas mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la/ /zhes pa rnams kyis phrin las bcol la/ so so'i rgyud bskul nas dngos grub blang ba'i phyir sngags kyi bzlas pa bya ste/

oṃ kṛṣ+ṇa ru drā yai swā hā/ oṃ ma hā ru drā ye swā hā/ oṃ de ba dāt+tā sa mā shri ye swāhā/ oṃ kṛṣ+ṇa ye swāhā/ oṃ a ka rā lā ya swā hā/ oṃ bhat+sā ya swā hā/ oṃ nan+de tā ya swā hā/ oṃ bi nā ya kā ya swā hā/ oṃ tsa muṇ+ḍī ye swā hā/ oṃ gau rī ye swā hā/ oṃ bi bhat+sā yai swā hā/ oṃ u ma de bī tsa mā ta rā ye swā hā/ oṃ dzā yā yai swā hā/ oṃ bi dzā yañtsai bā ya swā hā/ oṃ a dzī tā yai swā hā/ /oṃ a pa rā dzī tā yai swā hā/ oṃ bha dra kā lī ye swā hā/ oṃ ma hā kā lī ye swā hā/ oṃ s+thū la kā lī ye swā hā/ oṃ dzo (《 zha 》 yo ) gi nīn+dū ye swā hā/ oṃ tsan+d+rī ye swā hā/ oṃ gau rī ye swā hā/ oṃ duṣ+tā yai swā hā/ oṃ laṃ ba kī ye swā hā/ oṃ triṃ sha ta shwa rī ye swā hā/ oṃ kaṃ po tsī ye swā hā/ oṃ dī pī yai swā hā/ oṃ tsuṃ pin+yā gra ma ba s+thī ta yo gi nī ye swā hā/ oṃ gau rī rū pī ye swā hā/ oṃ ma hā rū pī ye swā hā/ oṃ daṃṣ+tā ∶ ka rā lī (《 zha 》 a ra ) ye swā hā/ oṃ ka pā li ye swā hā/ oṃ ka pā la mā li nī ye swā hā/ oṃ mā li nā+-i ye swā hā/ oṃ kha ṭāṃ ga nī ye swāhā/ oṃ ma hā dhi kā yai swā hā/ oṃ khaḍ+gā ∶ sti nī (《 zha 》 na ) ye swā hā/ oṃ pa ra shu hasti nī ye swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra hasti nā+-i ye swā hā/ oṃ dha nu hasti nī ye swā hā/ zhes bya ba'i sngags rnams re re la'ang brgya rtsa brgyad la sogs pa bzla'o/ /slar yang mchod de dngos grub blangs la bzod par gsol nas/ oṃ kṛṣ+ṇa ru drā gats+tsha/ zhes kun la sbyar te gshegs su gsol/ rim pa 'di nyid kyis thun gsum mam bzhi la sogs par gtong ngo*/ /yongs su rdzogs pa dang las kyi rjes mi mngon par bsdu'o/ /shin tu bsdus te gtong bar 'dod na/ spyan 'dren pa'i tshigs su bcad pa dang*/

sngags kyis spyan drangs pa'i mthar/ oṃ tista hūm̐ zhes pa la sogs pa 'ba' zhig gis phul nas phrin las bcol la gshegs su gsol/ rgyas pa dang bsdus pa gnyis char gyi phrin las bcol pa'i mthar/ chos kyi sbyin pa dang bden pa'i stobs brjod par bya'o/ /lho phyogs su bya ba 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor ma'i cho ga rdzogs so// // ༄༅/ nub phyogs klu'i gtor ma bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /dpal rdo rje 'dzin pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nub tu dri yi dkyil 'khor la/ /me tog ser dang dkar pos mchod/ /'o ma khrag bsres mngar gsum dang*/ /'o mas bkang ba'i gser snod dbul/ /tsan+dan dmar po la sogs pa'i rang bzhin las grub pa'i dri'i dkyil 'khor zlum por byas pa'i dbus su me tog gi tshom bu'am thig le sum cu rtsa gcig bkod la/ rang nyid 'jig rten dbang phyug la sogs pa'i nga rgyal bsgoms shing bzlas pa byas la/ mchod pa byin gyis brlabs nas/ skad cig ma'i ting nge 'dzin gyis dkyil 'khor dang mtshan ma rnams gzhal yas khang dang klu'i gtso bo sum cu rtsa gcig tu bskyed la/ oṃ bā ta li ma hā bā ta li hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ dzaḥswā hā/ oṃ klu rgyal mtha' yas nor rgyas bu/ /'jog po dang ni stobs kyi rgyu/ /pad+ma pad+ma chen po dang*/ /dung skyong dang ni rigs ldan no/ /lha mo lha mo chen mo dang*/ /zla ba'i spyi gtsug spyi gtsug che/ /dbyug 'dzin dbyug 'dzin chen po dang*/ /sog ma med dang hu lun ta

| | dga' bo dang ni nye dga' bo/ /rgya mtsho rgya mtsho chen po dang*/ /tsha ba tsha ba chen po dang*/ /dpal gyi 'od dang 'od po che/ /rin chen 'od dang gzugs mdzes dang*/ /gzugs mdzes chen po sbrul bzang dang*/ /ltau 'phye dang ni smig rgyu dang | | smig rgyu chen po pa rnams dag /mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol | | dngos grub don du bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ ā gats+tsha ya ā gats+tsha ya ma hā nā ga a dhi pa ∶ ti (《 zha 》 ta ye ) sarba bhur+bhu ba phruṃ phruṃ swā hā/ zhes pas lan gsum gyis spyan drangs nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥs gnyis su med par bstim/ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ gyis so so la gdan phul nas/ so so la mchod pa dang gtor ma dbul bar bya ste/ so so'i phyag rgya dang ting nge 'dzin dang ldan pas/ dri med yid du 'ong ba yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod yon 'di/ /klu rgyal mtha' yas nyid la dbul | | bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /oṃ a nan+tā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ de bzhin du me tog dang*/ spos dang*/ dri dang*/ mar me dang*/ zhal zas dang | rol mo dang*/ gdugs dang*/ ba dan rnams la sbyar te dbul bar bya'o// rdo rje khu tshur dam bcings te/ /mthe bong mthe'u chung sbrel bar bya/ /lag pa g.yas ni rab phye ste/ /sbrul gyi gdugs kyi tshul du sbyar/ /oṃ bhak+ṣa ya bhak+ṣa ya sa mā ya tiṣ+ṭhā dzaḥdz+rum̐ hūm̐ phruṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum mam bdun gyis gtor ma dbul lo/ /de bzhin du nor rgyas bu la dbul bar bgyi/ /oṃ ba su ∶ kā ye (《 zha 》 ke ) gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghāṃ swā hā/ klu rgyal 'jog po nyid la dbul/ /oṃ tāk+ṣa kā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ stobs kyi rgyu la dbul bar bgyi/ oṃ kerko ṭā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghṃ swāhā/ klu rgyal pad+ma nyid la dbul/ oṃ pad+mā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ pad+ma chen po nyid la dbul/ /oṃ ma hā pad+mā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghāṃ swā hā/ klu rgyal dung skyong nyid la dbul

| | oṃ shaṃ kha pā lā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ klu rgyal rigs ldan nyid la dbul | | oṃ ku lī kā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghāṃ swā hā/ klu rgyal lha mo nyid la dbul/ /oṃ de ba tī ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ lha mo chen mo nyid la dbul/ /oṃ ma hā de ba tī ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghāṃ swā hā/ zla ba'i spy-i gtsug nyid la dbul/ /oṃ sau ma shi khā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghāṃ swā hā/ spy-i gtsug chen po nyid la dbul/ /oṃ ma hā shi khā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghāṃ swā hā | klu rgyal dbyug 'dzin nyid la dbul/ /oṃ daṇ+ḍa dhā rā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghāṃ swā hā/ dbyug 'dzin chen po nyid la dbul/ /oṃ ma hā daṇ+ḍa dhā rā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ klu rgyal sog ma med la dbul/ /oṃ a pā la lā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghāṃ swā hā/ klu rgyal hu lun+ta la dbul/ /oṃ hu lun+ta ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ klu rgyal dga' bo nyid la dbul | | oṃ ∶ nan+tā ya (《 zha 》 nan dā ye ) gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ (《 zha 》+ klu rgyal nye dga' nyid la 'bul/ oṃ u pa nan dā ye grih+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ ) klu rgyal rgya mtsho nyid la dbul/ /oṃ sā ga rā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ rgya mtsho chen po nyid la dbul/ /oṃ ma hā sā ga rā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ klu rgyal tsha ba nyid la dbul/ /oṃ tap+tā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ tsha ba chen po nyid la dbul/ /oṃ ma hā tap+tā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ klu rgyal dpal gyi 'od la dbul/ /oṃ shrī kān+tāya gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ klu rgyal 'od po che la dbul | | oṃ ma hā kān+dāya gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ klu rgyal rin chen 'od la dbul// oṃ rat+na kān+tā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ klu rgyal gzugs mdzes nyid la dbul/ oṃ sū rū pā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ gzugs mdzes chen po nyid la dbul/ /oṃ ma hā sū rū pā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/

klu rgyal sbrul bzang nyid la dbul/ /oṃ bha dra de hi kaṃ gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ klu rgyal lto 'phye nyid la dbul/ /oṃ ma ho ra gā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ klu rgyal smig rgyu nyid la dbul/ /oṃ tshi li ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ smig rgyu chen po nyid la dbul/ oṃ ma hā tshi li ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ de ltar mchod pa dang gtor mas mnyes par byas nas/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la/ /zhes pa rnams kyis phrin las bcol la/ so so'i rgyud bskul nas dngos grub blang ba'i don du sngags kyi bzlas pa bya ste/ oṃ a nan+tā ya swā hā/ oṃ ba su kā ya swā hā/ oṃ tā k+ṣa kā ya swāhā*/ oṃ karko ṭā ya swā hā/ oṃ pad+mā ya swā hā/ oṃ ma hā pad+mā ya swā hā/ oṃ shaṃ kha pā lā ya swā hā/ oṃ ku li kā ya swā hā/ oṃ da ba tī ya swā hā/ oṃ ma hā de ba tī ya swāhā/ oṃ sau ma shi khā ya swā hā/ oṃ ma hā shi khā ya swā hā/ oṃ daṇ+ḍa dhā rā ya swā hā/ oṃ ma hā daṇ+ḍa dhā rā ya swā hā/ oṃ a bā la lā ya swā hā/ oṃ hu lun+tā ya swā hā/ oṃ nan+dā ya swā hā/ oṃ u pa nan+dā ya swā hā/ oṃ sā ga rā ya swā hā/ oṃ ma hā sā ga rā ya swā hā/ oṃ tap+tā ya swā hā/ oṃ ma hā tap+tā ya swā hā/ oṃ shrī kān+tā ya swā hā | oṃ ma hā kān+tā ya swā hā/ oṃ rat+na kān+tā ya swā hā/ oṃ sū rū pā ya swā hā/ oṃ ma hā sū rū pā ya swā hā/ oṃ bha dra de hi kaṃ swā hā/ oṃ ma ho ra ga ye swā hā/ oṃ tshi li ye swā hā | oṃ ma hā tshi li ye swā hā/ zhes bya ba'i sngags rnams re re la'ang brgya rtsa brgyad la sogs pa bzla'o/ /slar yang mchod de dngos grub blangs la bzod par gsol nas/ oṃ a nan+ta gats+tsha zhes kun la sbyar te gshegs su gsol lo/ / rim pa 'di nyid kyis thun gsum mam bzhi la sogs pas gtong ngo*/ /yongs su rdzogs pa dang las kyi rjes mi mngon par bsdu'o/

/shin tu bsdus te gtong bar 'dod na spyan 'dren pa'i tshigs su bcad pa dang*/ sngags kyis spyan drangs pa'i mthar/ oṃ bhak+ṣa ya bhak+ṣa ya zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i sngags 'ba' zhig gis phul nas phrin las bcol la gshegs su gsol/ rgyas pa dang bsdus pa gnyis char gyis phrin las bcol ba'i mthar chos kyi sbyin pa dang*/ bden pa'i stobs brjod par bya'o/ /nub phyogs su bya ba klu thams cad pa'i gtor ma'i cho ga rdzogs so// // ༄༅/ /byang phyogs gnod sbyin gyi gtor ma bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /dpal rdo rje 'dzin pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang du dkyil 'khor gru gsum pa/ /tsan+dan dmar po la sogs bya/ /me tog dmar sogs nye bar brgyan | | sā la'i 'bras chan sbrang rtsi zho/ /bdud rtsi lnga ldan snod gsum bzhag/thig le'am tshom bu nyi shu rtsa lnga dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bkod la/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po phyag na rdo rje la sogs pa'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas bzlas pa ci rigs pa byas te/ mchod pa bsang sbyang byin gyis brlabs nas/ skad cig ma'i ting nge 'dzin gyis dkyil 'khor dang mtshan ma rnams la gzhal yas khang dang | gnod sbyin gyi gtso bo dang*/ gtso mo nyi shu rtsa lngar bskyed la/ 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i phyag rgya dang*/ /sngags 'di yis ni dgug par bya/ /nor bu bzang dang gang ba bzang*/ /bde ba bzang dang rgyal ba bzang*/ /dga' ba'i phur bu phur chen po/ /phur bu bzang dang pad+ma'i gtsug /dung gi gtsug phud gar dang ni/ / gar chen dang ni 'bigs byed ma/ /gcod pa ma dang rdzogs byed ma/ /nor dang nor kun nor bzang mo/ /gzugs bzang rol dang rol chen mo/ /bzhad dang rtse dang rnam par spyod/ /dpal bzang dang ni gzugs mdzes mo/ /rdo rje dbang phyug bka' 'di yis/ /gnod sbyin gnod sbyin mo spyan 'dren/ /hūm̐ he ho ā kar+ṣa ya sa ma ya dī pe hūm̐ hūm̐ dzaḥswā hā/ zhes pa dang*/ oṃ yak+ṣa yak+ṣi ni ā gats+tsha ya ā gats+tsha ya zhes lan gsum gyis spyan drangs nas/

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs gnyis su med par bstim la/ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ gyis so so la gdan phul nas so so la mchod pa dang gtor ma dbul bar bya ste/ /dri med yid du 'ong ba yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod yon 'di/ /nor bu bzang la dbul bar bgyi/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /oṃ ba su bha drā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swāhā/ de bzhin du me tog dang | spos dang*/ dri dang*/ mar me dang*/ zhal zas dang*/ rol mo dang*/ gdugs dang*/ rgyal mtshan dang*/ ba dan rnams la sbyar te dbul bar bya'o/ / rdo rje bcings bskor snying gar bzhag /sngags 'dis mnyes par byas la gtong | | oṃ dhā nā dhi pa ta ye pa ta li phruṃ swā hā/ zhes pa gsum mam bdun gyis gtor ma dbul lo/ /de bzhin du/ gang ba bzang la dbul bar bgyi/ /oṃ pūr+ṇ+ṇa bha drā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ bde ba bzang la dbul bar bgyi/ /oṃ su bha drā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ rgyal ba bzang la dbul bar bgyi/ /oṃ dza ya bha drā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ dga' ba'i phur bu nyid la dbul/ /oṃ nan+da kī lā ya gṛ h+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ phur bu chen mo nyid la dbul/ /oṃ ma hā kī lī ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ phur bu bzang la dbul bar bgyi/ /oṃ su kī lā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ /pad+ma'i gtsug la dbul bar bgyi/ /oṃ pad+ma shi kha ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ dung gi gtsug phud nyid la dbul/ /oṃ shaṃ kha shi kha ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ gnod sbyin gar gyi gtso la dbul/ /oṃ ni ḍa gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ gnod sbyin gar chen nyid la dbul | | oṃ ma hā ni ḍa gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ gnod sbyin 'bigs byed ma la dbul | | oṃ bhin+da nī ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghṃ swā hā/ gnod sbyin gcod pa ma la dbul// oṃ ts+tshe da nā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ gnod sbyin rdzogs byed ma la dbul/

/oṃ pū ra ṇā ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ gnod sbyin nor la dbul bar bgyi/ /oṃ dha nā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ nor kun la ni dbul bar bgyi/ /oṃ dhā na dā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ nor bzang mo la dbul bar bgyi/ /oṃ su dhā nā yai gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā | gnod sbyin gzugs bzang nyid la dbul bar bgyi/ /oṃ su rū pā yai gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ gnod sbyin rol pa mo la dbul/ /oṃ ke lī ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ gnod sbyin rol chen mo la dbul/ /oṃ ma hā ke lī ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ gnod sbyin bzhad pa mo la dbul/ oṃ ha si tā ye gṛṃh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ /gnod sbyin rtse ba mo la dbul/ /oṃ kṛ ḍi tā yai gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ rnam par bskyod la dbul bar bgyi | | oṃ bik+ṣau ta bha ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ /dpal bzang la ni dbul bar bgyi | | oṃ su shrī yai gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ gzugs mdzes ma la dbul bar bgyi// oṃ rū pa kan+tī ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ de ltar mchod pa dang gtor mas mnyes par byas nas/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la/ /zhes pa rnams kyis phrin las bcol la/ so so'i rgyud bskul nas dngos grub bslang ba'i phyir rigs sngags kyi bzlas pa bya ste/ oṃ bā su bha drā ye swā hā/ oṃ dā na a dhi pa ta ye swā hā/ oṃ pūr+ṇ+ṇa bha drā ya swā hā/ oṃ su bha drā ya (《 zha 》 ye ) swā hā/ oṃ dza ya bha drā ya swā hā/ oṃ nan+da kī lā ya swā hā/ oṃ ma hā kī lā ya swā hā/ oṃ su kī lā ya swā hā/ oṃ pad+ma shi kha ye swā hā/ oṃ shaṃ kha shi kha ye swā hā/ oṃ ni ḍā ya swā hā/ oṃ ma hā ni ḍā ya swā hā/ oṃ bhin+da nī ye swā hā/ oṃ ts+tshe da nī ye swā hā/ oṃ sū ra ṇī ye swā hā/ oṃ dhā nā ya swā hā/ oṃ dhā na dā ya swā hā/

oṃ su dhā nā yai swā hā/ (《 zha 》+ oṃ bha tra dā nā ye swā hā/ ) oṃ sū rū pa ye swā hā/ oṃ ke lī ye swā hā/ oṃ ma hā ke lī ye swā hā/ oṃ hā si tā yai swā hā/ oṃ kṛ ḍi tā yai swā hā/ oṃ bik+ṣo bhā ya swā hā/ oṃ su shri ye swā hā/ oṃ rū pa kan+tī ye swā hā/ zhes bya ba'i sngags rnams re re la'ang brgya rtsa brgyad la sogs par bzla'o/ /slar yang mchod de dngos grub blangs nas bzod par gsol la/ oṃ ba su bha dra gats+tsha/ zhes kun la sbyar te gshegs su gsol lo/ /rim pa 'di nyid kyis thun gsum mam bzhi la sogs par gtong ngo*/ /yongs su rdzogs pa dang las kyi rjes mi mngon par bsdu'o/ /shin tu bsdus te gtong bar 'dod na/ spyan 'dren pa'i tshigs su bcad pa dang*/ sngags kyis spyan drangs pa'i mthar/ oṃ dhā nā a dhi pa ta ye la sogs pa'i sngags 'ba' zhig gis phul nas phrin las bcol la gshegs su gsol/ rgyas pa dang bsdus pa gnyis char gyis phrin las bcol ba'i mthar chos kyi sbyin pa dang*/ bden pa'i stobs brjod par bya'o/ /byang phyogs su bya ba gnod sbyin thams cad pa'i gtor ma'i cho ga rdzogs so// // ༄༅/ /sa skya pa'i nyin zhag phrugs gcig gi thugs dam gtor ma'i rim pa bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos rje sa skya pa yab sras kyi nyin zhag phrugs gcig la thugs dam du mdzad pa'i gtor ma'i rim pa ni | tsha ba'i gong tho rangs kyi cha la/ dkar gtor bzhi mdzad pa'i thog mar rje btsun mi g.yo ba la dbul te/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ (《 zha 》+ hūm̐ ) phaṭa ces brjod pas gtor ma'i ma dag pa bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha s+sarba dhārmāḥ swa bhā wa shud+dho3ham̐/ gis stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las/ oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang bar bsams la/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi byin gyis brlab/ de nas rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ rje btsun mi g.yo ba mdun gyi nam mkha' spyan drangs la/ gtor ma phul bas gsol bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa lan gsum mam/ bdun gyis phul nas/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra dhu pe āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra ā lo āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas mchod nas/ kye kye mtha' gnyis rnam par ma g.yos shing*/ /sprul pa'i gzugs kyis 'gro don dpag med mdzad/ /'jigs byed chen po 'gro ba kun sgrol zhing*/ /srid pa gsum na dgyes pa'i gar mdzad de/ /srid pa'i chu bo skems shing mi mthun bdud rnams 'joms/ /srid pa'i rlung gis ma g.yos thugs rje mi g.yo mgon/ /rab brjid mi g.yo mgon la gus pas phyag 'tshal bstod | | ces pas bstod nas/ bdag gi bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi ba dang | 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab bo/ /mi g.yo ba'i drug cu rtsa bzhi pa

(《 zha 》 ma ) la sogs pa gtong bar 'dod na'ang tshul 'di nyid kyis gtang bar bya'o/ / gnyis pa snga ma ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ lho phyogs ri bo po ta la na/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma 'khor dang bcas pa mngon sum du bzhugs pa la phul bar bsam zhing*/ na maḥsarba bud+dha bo dhi sa twā nāṃ a pra ti ha ta shā sa nā nāṃ he he bha ga wa te ma hā satwa/ sarba bud+dha a wa lo ki te/ mā bi laṃ pa/ mā bi laṃ pa/ i daṃ ba liṃ grih+nā pa ya grih+nā pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ sarba bi sañtsa re swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis phul nas/ snga ma ltar mchod la/ lha dang lha min cod pan gyis/ /zhabs kyi (《 zha 》 gnyis ) pad+mo la btud pa/ /phongs pa kun las sgrol mdzad ma/ /sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo | | zhes pas bstod nas snga ma ltar gsol ba gdab bo/ /nyi shu rtsa gcig ma la sogs pa gtong bar 'dod na'ang tshul 'di nyid kyis gtang bar bya'o/ / gsum pa klu rnams la dbul te/ gtor ma la rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi phyag rgya bstan la/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐ zhes lan gsum brjod pas ma dag pa bsang*/ rdo rje me'i phyag rgya bstan nas/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wā la a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha bhañdza ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod pas rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba bdud rtsis gang bar bsam/ rdo rje bsdams pa'i phyag rgya 'debs pa'i tshul du bya zhing*/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ ād+ya nut+pan+na twād oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum brjod pas gtor ma las klu rnams kyis ci 'dod pa'i yo byad thogs pa med par 'byung bar bsam/ 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i phyag rgya bcas la/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas klu'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ bye brag tu rang la gnod par byed pa'i klu thams cad spyan drangs par bsam zhing*/ oṃ ba ta li ba ta li/ ma hā ba ta li hūm̐ hūm̐ dzaḥdzaḥswā hā/ zhes lan gsum dang*/ oṃ klu rgyal mtha' yas nor rgyas bu/

/'jog po dang ni stobs kyi rgyu/ /pad+ma pad+ma chen po dang | | dung skyong dang ni rigs ldan no/ /lha mo lha mo chen mo dang*/ /zla ba'i spyi gtsug spy-i gtsug che/ /dbyug 'dzin dbyug 'dzin chen po dang*/ /sog ma med dang hu lun+tā/ /dga' bo dang ni nye dga' bo/ /rgya mtsho rgya mtsho chen po dang*/ /tsha ba tsha ba chen po dang*/ /dpal gyi 'od dang 'od po che/ /rin chen 'od dang gzugs mdzes dang*/ /gzugs mdzes chen po sbrul bzang dang*/ /lto 'phye che dang tshi li dang*/ /tshi li chen po rnam dag ni/ /mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /zhes pa dang*/ oṃ ā gats+tsha ya/ a gats+tsha ya/ ma hā nā ga a dhi pa ta ye/ sarba bhur+bhu ba phruṃ phuḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes brjod pas mdun du byon par bsam/ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes pas so so la pad+ma'i gdan dbul/ oṃ ma hā nā ga a dhi pa ta ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ/ zhes kun la sbyar la/ ar+ghaṃ swā hās mchod yon/ pād+yaṃ swā hās zhabs bsil | puṣ+baṃ swā hās me tog dhū paṃ swā hās bdug spos/ dī paṃ swā hās mar me/ gan+dhaṃ swā hās dri/ nai bi d+ye swā hās zhal zas phul nas klu thams cad kyis gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing*/ klu dga' bar byed pa'i phyag rgya bcas nas/ oṃ hi li hi li ma hā hi li phruṃ ∶ phraṃ (《 zha 》 phruṃ phruṃ ) phraṃ swā hā/ zhes brjod nas se gol brdabs pas gtor snod re re la gsum gsum dang*/ oṃ bhak+ṣa ya bhak+ṣa ya sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha dzuṃ phruṃ phuḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gsum brjod pas phul nas/ ye dharmā dang | sdig pa ci yang mi bya ste/ /dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad/ /rang gi sems ni yongs su gdul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ /zhes chos kyi sbyin pa byin nas/ klu'i rgyal po brgyad kyis gtso byas pa'i klu'i rigs su gyur pa thams cad dang*/ bye brag tu bdag la gnod cing*/ lan chags pa'i klu dang*/ sa bdag thams cad gtor ma 'dis tshim par gyur cig

gnod pa dang gdug pa'i sems nye bar zhi nas/ phan pa dang byang chub kyi sems dang ldan par gyur cig ces brjod nas/ oṃ nā ga a dhi pa ti/ sa pa ri wā ra gats+tsha/ zhes brjod pas rang rang gi gnas su gshegs par bsam/ bya khyung gi phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ ga ru ḍa haṃ sa he tsa le tsa le (《 zha 》 la ) swāhā/ zhes brjod pas nag po'i klu'i rigs thams cad bskrad par bsam mo/ /bzhi pa su rū pa'i sngags kyis yi dwags rnams la sbyin par bya ste/ rang skad cig gis de bzhin gshegs pa gzugs mdzes su bsgoms la/ gtor ma oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por byin gyis brlabs nas/ lag pa g.yas pa mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya byas la/ na maḥ su rū pā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te saṃmyak+saṃ bud+dha ya/ tad+yathā/ oṃ su ru su ru | pra su ru pra su ru/ ta ra ta ra/ bha ra bha ra/ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra/ sma ra sma ra san+tarba ya/ sarba pre tā nāṃ swā hā/ zhes lan bdun brjod pas yi dwags rnams kyi mdun du zad mi shes pa'i bdud rtsi dang*/ 'dod pa'i yon tan thams cad 'byung bar bsam zhing*/ a pa sa ran+tu a ba tā ra/ pre k+ṣi ṇod+dā me ham̐/ sarba lo ka dhā tu bha sī naṃ/ sarba pre tā ∶ nā ma hā raṃ (《 zha 》 nan ) / zhes brjod pas phan tshun 'dzer ba dang*/ 'thab rtsod la sogs pa med par ci bde bar mnyam por thob cing | longs spyad nas bde bar tshim par bsam mo/ /de nas ye dharmā la sogs pas chos kyi sbyin pa byin nas/ sgrib pa gnyis byang*/ se gol brdabs pas rang gi gnas su byer bar bsam mo/ /'di'i phan yon ni/ skye ba nas skye bar dbul por mi 'gyur ba dang*/ stobs che ba dang*/ gzugs bzang zhing mthong na dga' bar 'gyur ba dang*/ phyug cing longs spyod che ba dang*/ tshe ring ba dang | nad med pa dang*/ myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par 'gyur ro/ /shi 'phos nas kyang 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur ro/

/zhes mdo las 'byung ngo*/ /de nas kha zas mi thob pa'i yi dwags rnams la chu sbyin par bya ste/ rang skad cig gis 'phags pa sbyan ras gzigs dbang phyug zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas pa mchog sbyin byas par bsgoms la/ chu dang snod la sogs pa thams cad zas kyis ma gos par bya zhing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi byin gyis brlabs pa/ lag pa g.yas pa'i mthil du mthe bong bzhag nas/ spyan ras gzigs kyi phyag g.yas pa nas byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis kha 'bar ma dang 'jur gegs la sogs pa'i yi dwags kyi tshogs thams cad tshim par bsam zhing*/ oṃ āḥhrīḥhūm̐ zhes ci rigs pa bgrangs pa'i mthar oṃ dz+wa la mi daṃ sarba pre te bh+yaḥ swāhā/ zhes bya bas kyang bsngos nas/ 'phags pa sbyan ras gzigs dbang gi /phyag nas 'bab pa'i 'o rgyun gyis/ / yi dwags rnams ni tshim gyur nas/ khrus byas rtag tu bsil bar shog /ces brjod la slar yang chos kyi sbyin pa byin nas/ se gol brdabs pas rang rang gi gnas su byer bar bsam mo/ / (《 zha 》+ de nas ) gshin rje gshed dgra nag po'i rgyud las/ lo re'am ni zla re'am/ /de bzhin nyi ma so so la/ /gtor ma drug cu rtsa bzhi gtang*/ /dbyu gu drug cu bzhir shes bya/ /zhes 'byung bas nyi ma gung gi cha la rdo rje pho nya mo drug cu rtsa bzhi mnyes shing*/ dbyu gu drug cu rtsa bzhis dus la bar chad mi 'byung bar bya ba'i phyir/ gtor ma drug cu rtsa bzhir mdzad de/ sha khrag dang ma 'dres pa'i gtor ma grangs drug cu rtsa bzhi 'byung ba bshams la/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ sems bskyed pa sngon du song nas rang skad cig gis yi dam gyi lhar bsam/ gtor ma oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi byin gyis brlabs pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsis 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshogs thams cad mchod par bsam zhing*/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ/ ād+ya nut+pan+na twāta/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā

| zhes pas bsngos nas/ 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams mnyes shing*/ rigs drug gi sems can thams cad tshim par gyur cig /ces brjod do/ /de'i rjes la yang snga ma ltar yi dwags rnams la chu sbyin par bya'o/ /de nas rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa bdun dang sbyor ba nyi shu rtsa bdun gyi gnod pa mi 'byung bar bya ba'i phyir/ gtor ma nyi shu rtsa bdun ma gtang bar bya ste/ sum tshan dgur byas pa'i dang po rje btsun mi g.yo ba dang*/ gnyis pa rje btsun ma sgrol ma la snga ma ltar phul la gsol ba gdab/ gsum pa'i dang po sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang*/ gnyis pa rang gi chos skyong dang*/ gsum pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma spy-i la/ a kā ro'i sngags kyis dbul/ bzhi pa lha'i drang srong dang*/ lnga pa lhan cig skyes pa'i lha dang*/ drug pa rigs drug dang*/ bdun pa yi dwags dang | brgyad pa lan chags dang glo bur du lhags pa'i 'byung po rnams sbyin te/ thams cad kyang oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs nas/ lag pa g.yas pa mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya bcas la/ mgron so so la mchod cing*/ sbyin par bsams la/ namaḥsarba ta thā ga ta/ a ba lo ki ta (《 zha 》 te ) / oṃ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra hūm̐/ zhes gtor ma'i snod re re la'ang lan gsum gsum mam bdun bdun brjod pas phul nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mang la phyag 'tshal lo | | zhes brjod pas gtor ma 'dod pa'i longs spyod lngas brgyan pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po dpag tu med par gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa gzugs dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes brjod pas gtor ma'i mgron rnams nad med cing gzugs phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa sku 'byams klas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes brjod pas gnod pa med cing lus la phan par longs spyod par gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'jigs pa thams cad dang bral ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes brjod pas gnod pa dang*/

'jigs pa thams cad dang bral bar gyur par bsam mo/ kha 'bar ma'i brgya rtsa gtong bar 'dod pas kyang*/ tshul 'di nyid kyis gtong bar bya'o/ /dgu pa a kā ro'i sngags kyis gzhi'i bdag po rnams la sbyin no/ /de'i mthar yang yi dwags rnams la chu sbyin par bya'o/ /'jig rten pa'i mgron de dag thams cad la'ang*/ thun mong du chos kyi sbyin pa'ang sbyin zhing*/ 'dod pa'i don rnams kyang bsgo bar bya'o | | de nas se gol brdabs nas/ oṃ sarba bhū ta gats+tsha/ zhes brjod pas mgron rnams rang rang gi gnas su dengs par bsams nas/ dge ba'i rtsa ba rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo'o/ /de nas phyogs skyong dang 'byung po'i gtor ma ni | dkar gtor gtsang ma gnyis bshams pa klu gtor ltar byin gyis brlabs pa la/ rang yi dam gyi lha'i nga rgyal brtan po dang ldan pa'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas/ phyogs skyong ba bcu po 'khor dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs par bsam zhing*/ shar phyogs rdo rje can gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas | | gtor ma phul ba 'di dag bzhes su gsol/ /me dang gshin rje bden bral srin po'i bdag /chu bdag rlung bdag nor gyi bdag po dang*/ / dbang ldan lha ste 'byung po'i bdag po dang*/ /steng gi nyi zla tshangs pa chen po dang | | lha rnams kun dang gang dag sa steng klu/ /ri yi lha dang gtsang ma'i tshogs bcas la/ /sa sa so sor gtor ma phul ba 'di (《 zha 》 rnams ) / /rab tu dgyes pa'i tshul gyis bzhes nas su/ /rang rang phyogs su legs par bzhugs nas kyang*/ /rang gi bu smad mdza' bshes gnyen 'dun dang*/ /nang mi dmag dang dpung bcas lhan cig tu/ /phreng ba me tog dri dang bdug par bcas/ / bstod dang gtor ma mar me gus 'bul na/ /'di dag gsol zhing legs par bsnams nas su/ /rang rang phyogs su legs par bzhugs nas kyang*/ /bdag gi las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ oṃ in+d+rā ya/ ag+na ye/ ya mā ya/

nai t+ye | bā ru ṇā ya/ bā ya be/ ku be rā ya/ ī sha nā ya/ ur+dhāṃ brah+ma/ sūr+ya gra ha/ a dhi pa ta ye/ tsan+d+ra nak+ṣa tra a dhi pa ta ye e h+ye hi/ zhes pas spyan drangs/ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ gyis gdan dbul/ oṃ da sha dika lo ka pā la gṛh+ṇe daṃ zhes kun la sbyar la/ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ pād+yaṃ swā hā/ puṣ+paṃ swā hā/ dhu paṃ swā hā/ dī paṃ swā hā/ gan+dhaṃ swā hās mchod pa rnams phul nas/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ zhes brjod pas dam la bzhag par bsam | de nas gtor ma phul ba phyogs skyong ba 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyis gsol bas/ tshim par bsam zhing*/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ in+d+rā ya (《 zha 》 ye ) zhes pa nas/ tsan+d+ra nak+ṣa tra a dhi pa ta ye/ zhes pa'i bar gyi mthar/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ uṅga te/ s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ṇe daṃ ba lin+ta ye swā hā/ zhes brjod nas se gol brdabs pa gsum mam bdun gyis phul la/ slar yang ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod de/ dbang po rdo rje 'chang ba'i lha/ /lha yi rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar phyogs gdon gyi tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /me ste bsreg bya za ba'i lha/ /drang srong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar lho gdon gyi tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /gshin rje be con 'chang ba'i lha/ /ma mo'i rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /lho phyogs gdon gyi tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /bden dang bral ba legs ldan lha/ /srin po'i rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /lho nub gdon gyi tshogs bcas la | | mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /zhags pa thogs pa chu yi lha/ /klu yi rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /nub phyogs gdon gyi tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /rlung ste srog kyang 'dzin pa'i lha/ /rig 'dzin rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /nub byang gdon gyi tshogs bcas la/
