/mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /gnod sbyin lag na dbyug to thogs/ /nor skyong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /byang phyogs gdon gyi tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /dbang dang ldan pa 'dren pa'i lha/ /'byung po'i rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /byang shar gdon gyi tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /steng gi tshangs pa chen po dang*/ /nyi ma zla ba gza' chen po | | gza' dang rgyu skar bcas pa la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// 'og gi klu ste sa yi bdag /sa 'dzin lag pa chen po dang*/ /dam tshig shes pa'i tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /zhes pas bstod nas | rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang | | dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang*/ /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing | | zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ / dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs/ /dngos grub kun gyis stong grogs mdzod// dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*/ /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod | | rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /

'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*/ /'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang*// bde legs thams cad 'byung ba dang*/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog / ces pas phrin las bcol nas/ dngos grub ma lus pa gnang bar bsam mo/ / yang rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros pas/ lha klu khyad par can rnams kyis gtso byas pa 'byung po'i tshogs rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar bkug par bsam zhing*/ lha dang lha min gnod sbyin lto 'phye grul/ /nam mkha' lding dang 'dab bzangs (《 zha 》 bzang ) lus srul po/ /dri za srin po gdon gyi tshogs rnams dang*/ /gang dag sa la gnas pa'i rdzu 'phrul can/ /bu smad bcas shing 'khor g.yog bcas pa la/ /bdag gi pus mo sa la btsugs nas ni/ /thal mo sbyar nas khyed la gsol 'debs kyis/ /gsan nas phan gdags slad du 'dir gshegs shig/oṃ de wa nā ga yak+ṣa gan+dhar+bha/ a su ra/ ga ru ḍa/ kin+na ra/ ma ho ra ga ma nu ṣ+ya/ a ma nu ṣ+ya/ e h+ye his spyan drangs/ snga ma ltar gdan dbul/ mchod pas mchod | dam la bzhag nas/ oṃ de wa nas/ a ma nu ṣ+ya'i bar gyi mthar/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te la sogs pas phyag rgya dang bcas pa gsum mam bdun gyis gtor ma phul ba thams cad kyis gsol zhing mnyes par bsgoms la/ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod nas/ 'byung po gang dag ri rab steng gnas dang*/ /dga' ba'i tshal dang lha yi gnas rnams dang*/ /shar nub ri dang nyi zla'i khyim rnams dang | | ri bo kun la gang dag gnas pa dang*/ /rin chen gling na lhag par gang gnas dang*/ /chu bo kun dang chu bo'i mdo rnams dang*/ /mtsho dang rdzing bu lteng ka chu ngogs dang*/ /g.ya' chu sil ma can na ∶ gnas pa (《 zha 》 gang gnas ) dang*/ / grong dang phyugs lhas grong khyer stong pa dang*/ khang stong dag dang lha yi khang pa dang | | gtsug lag khang dang mchod rten gnas rnams dang*/ /dka' thub gnas dang glang chen bres rnams dang*/ /rgyal po'i dkor khang dag na gang gnas dang | | lam srang sum mdo dang bzhi mdo dang*/

/gang dag lam po che dang shing gcig drung*/ /dur khrod chen po nags tshal chen po dang*/ /seng ge dred dang gcan gzan gnas rnams dang*/ /'brog chen 'jigs su rung bar gang gnas dang | | gang dag gling mchog dag na gnas pa dang*/ /lhun po dur khrod dag na gnas pa rnams/ /rab tu dgyes shing mgu bar gyur nas ni/ /phreng ba me tog dri dang byug pa dang*/ /bstod dang gtor ma mar me gus 'bul na/ /'di dag gsol zhing legs par bzhes nas kyang*/ /bdag gi las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ /ces pas phrin las gzhol lo/ /de nas phyogs skyong ba dang*/ 'byung po rnams la/ ye dharmā dang*/ sdig pa thams cad mi bya ste/ /la sogs pa'i chos kyi sbyin pa byin nas/ bdag cag gi sngon gyi las las gyur pa dang*/ 'phral gyi rkyen las gyur pa'i bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi ba dang*/ dpal dang 'byor pa rgyas pa dang*/ bsam pa thams cad chos bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa la sogs pa'i 'dod pa'i don gsol ba btab nas/ oṃ in+d+ra gats+tsha/ oṃ de wa gats+tsha la sogs pa brjod cing*/ se gol gtogs te gshegs su gsol lo/ /de nas srod kyi dus la sogs par bya ba/ yi dam so so dang chos skyong gi gtor ma ni/ so so'i sgrub thabs las shes par bya'o/ / 'dir bris pa thams cad bya bar ma nus na'ang*/ gang la spro ba dang*/ ji tsam nus pa gtang bar bya ste/ sngags kyi theg pa'i tshul gyis/ gtor ma la brten nas | 'phags pa mchod pa/ sems can thams cad la sbyin pa rnam pa bzhis tshim par bya ba dang*/ gnas skabs su las bzhi 'grub cing*/ khyad par du bar chad zhi ba dang*/ sbyor ba byang chub kyi sems kyi kun slong*/ dngos gzhi 'khor gsum dag pa'i rgya dang rjes yongs su bsngo bas zin na ni/ mchog gi dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs kyi mchog tu 'gyur te/ gtor ma las rab kun gyi mchog/ ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar dpal sa skya pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyis phyag len du mdzad pa'i/

gtor ma gtong ba'i tshul 'di dag rang gi slob ma las dang po pa mang pos bskul ba'i don du 'phags pas lcags mo lug gi lo/ bya sbo'i zla ba'i tshes nyi shu la shing kun du a tsa ra zhes bya bas yi ge pa byas te sbyar ba'o// // ༄༅/ /bgegs gtor bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /bgegs gtor ni bsang ba nas stobs brjod pa'i bar snga ma dang 'dra'o/ /de'i 'og tu bdag nyid khro bor gsal bar dmigs te khro bo gang yin pa de'i sngags brgya'am stong bzlas te bskul la/ sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang | chos kyi bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bden pa dang*/ gsang sngags dang rig sngags rnams kyi byin gyi brlabs kyis/ bgegs kyi rigs gang yin pa de dag thams cad skad cig yud tsam thang cig 'di nyid la 'dir mchis par gyur cig ces brjod pa lcags kyu 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i sngags dang phyag rgyas dgug par bya'o/ /mchod yon sbraing la mdun du byon par bsams la/ oṃ guṅka ri guṅkari swā hā/ oṃ pi tsi pi tsi swā hā/ oṃ gung gung swā hā/ zhes pa dang phyogs skyong mchod pa'i sngags/ gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ zhes pas mchod par bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu tshigs su bcad pa 'dis bsngo bar bya'o/ /gang zhig mtshan mor rgyu ba yi/ / 'byung po rnams dang sha za dang*/ /srin po sha rjen za ba dang*/ /sems can rnam pa sna tshogs pa/ /ljon shing gel pa la sogs gnas/ /de dang de la gtor ma ni | | bza' ba sha chang la phug bcas/ /'bras chan 'bras bu mang po sbyin/ / mchod pa 'di yis mgu byos la/ /gnod pa'i bsam pa zhi ba dang*/ /bdag cag rnams la phan pa'i yid/ /de ring phyin chad bskyed par gyis/ /zhes bya bas bsngo bar bya'o/ /de nas tshigs 'dis bden pa bdar te/ /rgyan gyis brgyan par byas kyang chos spyod cing*/ /dul zhing yang dag sdom la tshangs par spyod/ / 'byung po kun la chad pa spangs pa ste/ /dge slong dge sbyong de yin bram ze de/

/ mtshon chas mi 'jigs gang yang med/ /'chi ba'i srog la kun kyang 'dzem/ / rang gi lus la dpe long la/ /gzhan la gnod pa ma byed cig /oṃ chen po'am chung ngu gang dag gis/ /lus la mngon par gnod gyur pa'i/ /nad de nye bar phyung nas su/ /gdon de rang gi gnas su deng*/ /de ltar bdag gis ci nus kyis | | mchod dang bsnyen bkur byas pa yis/ /dam tshig gnas la gnas nas su/ /bdag gi bsam pa skong bar mdzod/ /rtag tu dam tshig la gnas shing | | 'dir ni che ge mo zhig gi /nad de rab tu bsal mdzod la/ /gdon rnams rang gi gnas su song*/ /zhes brjod la/ /sarba bigh+nāṃ gats+tsha zhes pas slar gtang | bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags kyis mtshams bcad pa ni/ na maḥs man+ta kā ya bāk+tsit+ta badz+rā ṇāṃ/ na mo badz+ra kro dhā ya/ ma hā daṃṣ+tā+ot+ka ṭa bhai ra wā ya/ a si mu sa la/ pa ra shu pā sha hastā ya/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ hu lu hu lu | tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ gardza gardza/ bis+pho ṭa ya bis+pho ṭa ya/ bighāṃ bi nā ya ka nā/ ma hā ga ṇa pa ti/ dzī bi ta an+ta ka rā ya swā hā/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa las 'byung ba'o/ /cha gsum gtor ma 'bring po'i cho ga rdzogs so// // ༄༅/ /klu gtor bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /klu gtor gtong bar 'dod pas/ dkar gtor gtsang ma bshams la/ skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed bya/ rang yi dam gyi lha gang rung du bsgom/ gtor ma la rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi phyag rgya bstan nas/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐ zhes lan gsum brjod pas ma dag pa bsang | rdo rje me'i phyag rgya bstan nas/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha bhañdza ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod pas/ rin po che'i snod kyi rgya chen po bdud rtsi gang bar bsam/ rdo rje bsdams pa'i phyag rgya 'debs pa'i tshul bya zhing*/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ ād+yanut+pan+na twāta/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/

zhes lan gsum brjod pas/ gtor ma las klu rnams kyis ci 'dod pa thogs pa med par 'byung bar bsam/ 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i phyag rgya bcas la/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros pas/ klu'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ bye brag tu rang la gnod (《 zha 》+ par byed ) pa thams cad spyan drangs par bsam zhing*/ oṃ ba ta li ba ta li ma hā ba ta li hūm̐ hūm̐ dzaḥdzaḥswā hā/ zhes lan gsum dang*/ oṃ klu rgyal mtha' yas nor rgyas bu/ /'jog pa dang mi stobs kyi rgyu/ /pad+ma pad+ma chen po dang | | dung skyong dang ni rigs ldan no/ /lha mo lha mo chen mo dang*/ /zla ba'i spyi gtsug spyi gtsug che/ /dbyug 'dzin dbyug 'dzin chen po dang*/ /sog ma med dang hu lun+ta/ /dga' bo dang ni nye dga' bo/ /rgya mtsho rgya mtsho chen po dang*/ /tsha ba tsha ba chen po dang*/ /dpal gyi 'od dang 'od po che/ /rin chen 'od dang gzugs mdzes dang*/ /gzugs mdzes chen po sbrul bzang dang*/ /lto 'phye che dang tshi li dang*/ /tshi li chen po rnams dang ni/ /mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ ā gats+tsha ya/ ā gats+tsha ya/ ma hā nā ga a dhi pa ta ye sarba bhur+bhu wa phruṃ phuḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes brjod pas mdun du byon par bsam/ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes brjod pas so so la pad+ma'i gdan dbul/ oṃ ma hā nā ga a dhi pa ta ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ zhes kun la sbyar la/ ar+ghaṃ swā hās mchod yon/ pād+yāṃ swā hās zhabs bsil | puṣ+paṃ swā hās me tog dhu paṃ swā hās bdug sbos/ dī paṃ swā hās mar me/ gan+dhṃ swā hās dri/ nai wid+ye swā hās zhal zas phul nas/ klu thams cad kyis gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing*/ klu dga' bar byed pa'i phyag rgya byas la/ oṃ hi li hi li/ ma hā li phruṃ phraṃ phraṃ phraṃ swāhā/ zhes brjod nas se gol brdabs pas gtor snod re re la gsum gsum dang*/ oṃ bhak+ṣa ya bhak+ṣa ya sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭhā rdzū phruṃ phuḥswāhā/

zhes lan gsum gsum brjod pas phul nas/ ye dharmā he tu pra bha wā he tun+te ṣān+ta thā ga to h+ya ba dat+te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e waṃ bā dī ma hā shra ma ṇaḥzhes pa dang*/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya ste/ /dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad/ /rang gi sems ni yongs su gdul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ /zhes chos kyi sbyin pa byin nas/ klu'i rgyal po chen po brgyad kyis gtso byas pa'i klu'i rigs su gyur pa thams cad dang | bye brag tu bdag la gnod cing lan chags pa'i klu dang sa bdag thams cad gtor ma 'dis tshim par gyur cig gnod pa dang gdug pa'i sems nye bar zhi nas/ phan pa dang byang chub kyi sems dang ldan par gyis shig ces brjod nas/ oṃ nā ga a dhi pa ta ye sa pa ri wā ra gats+tsha/ zhes brjod pas/ rang gi gnas su gshegs par bsam/ bya khyung gi phyag rgya bcas nas/ oṃ ga ru ḍa haṃ sa hai tsa la swā hā/ zhes brjod pas nag po'i rigs kyi klu gzhan thams cad bskrad par bsam/ gtor ma sa gtsang sar gtong*/ dge ba'i rtsa ba sangs rgyas su bsngo/ klu'i gtor ma rdo rje gdan bzhi'i rgyud las byung ba bzhin/ chos rje sa skya pas mdzad pa'i phyag len 'phags pas yi ger bkod pa'o// // ༄༅/ /chu gtor bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyu dang tshegs chung zhing phan yon dang 'bras bu che ba'i chu gtor gtang ba'i rim pa ni/ 'khar ba dang bse ma yin pa'i snod gtsang mar chu gtsang ma dang*/ phye gtsang ma dang me tog sna tshogs dang*/ sman lnga dang*/ 'bru lnga dang*/ rin po che lnga dang*/ dri lnga dang | dar sna tshogs pa btab la/ rang nyid bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs 'gro bya/ de nas sems can thams cad la dmigs pa'i tshad med bzhi bsgom | phyi nang gis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin med par bsgom/ rang bzhin med pa'i ngang nas/ oṃ bā gī shwa ri muṃ/ zhes pa'i sgra grags pas rang gi sems pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du muṃ ser po zhig tu bsam/

de'i mtha' mar oṃ bā gī shwa ri mum̐/ zhes pa'i yi ges g.yas phyogs su bskor bar bsgom/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ ral gri yu bar mum̐ gyis mtshan pa cig tu bsgom/ de las 'od zer phar 'phros 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus nas gcig tu gyur pa las rang 'phags pa 'jam dpal du gyur par bsam | pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pas ral gri nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon pas pu sti thugs kar 'dzin par bsam/ de'i sbyi bor hūm̐ sngon po zhig bsam | de nas zhu nas thim pas lus thams cad rdo rje'i go gyon par bsam/ sngags kyi bzlas pa'ang ci rigs par bya'o/ /de dag ni bsam rgyud kyi rim pa'o | | de nas yo byad brtag cing byin gyis brlab pa ni chos nyid rnam par dag pa'i phyag rgya bcings la/ oṃ swa bha wa bi shud+dha s+sarba dhārmāḥswa bha wa bi shud+dho3 haṃ/ zhes pas nyes pa'i skyon thams cad dag par bsam mo/ /nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bcings la/ oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ uṅga te s+pha ra ṇa i ma ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ zhes brjod pas gtor ma'i yo byad 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mgron so so'i mos pa dang mthun pa'i 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga'i yo byad nam mkha'i khams gang bar gyur par bsam/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i phyag rgya bcings la/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa ces brjod pas/ mgron so so'i lus kyi nad dang sems kyi zug rngu zhi bar byed pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsam mo/ /rgyal chen shugs ldan 'od kyi phyag rgya byas la/ na ma s+sarba ta thā ga ta a ba lo ki te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐ zhes brjod pas yo byad rnams 'phags pa rnams kyi spyan sngar gzhal yas khang bkod pa dpag tu med pa rnams kyis phyi nang kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin gyis gang ba'i mchod pa dang*/

sems can rnams kyi dbang po lnga'i spyod yul du so so'i bsam pa dang mthun pa'i 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga char gyi rgyun bzhin du babs par bsam/ ye shes skar mda'i phyag rgya byas la/ o dzñā na a ba lo ke te na maḥ sa man+ta s+pha ra ṇa rasmi bha wa sa ma ya ma hā ma ṇi du ru du ru hṛ da ya dza la ni hūm̐ | zhes brjod pas rang gi lus zhing gi rdul phra rab dang mnyam par gyur nas 'phags pa rnams la phul bas 'phags pa rnams mnyes par bsam/ gtor ma'i yo byad la mgron thams cad 'thab pa dang*/ rtsod pa med par mthun pa'i bsam pa dang ldan par gyur par bsam/ dbang sgyur 'khor lo'i phyag rgya bcas la | na ma s+sa man+ta bud+dhā nāṃ/ gra he shwa ri pra bhañdza ti ma hā sa ma ya swā hā/ zhes brjod pas sri zhu'i mgron dang*/ yon tan gyi mgron dang*/ snying rje'i mgron dang*/ lan chags kyi mgron du gyur pa thams cad la'ang dam tshig gi dbang gis bdag la 'go zhing stong grogs su 'gyur bar mngon sum du bsam/ gzhan yang sems can gyi don du 'gyur ba'i las (《 zha 》+ ci dang ci ) thams cad sgrub par bsam

| phyag rgya rnams phyogs bcur bstan zhing sngags rnams lan gsum mam bdun du brjod do/ /de nas mgron rnams spyan drang ba ni/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mgron thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar bsams la | na mo bde gshegs snying pos 'gro kun yongs la khyab/ /sems ni rgya chen mchog tu rab bskyed de/ /'gro ba 'di dag ma lus sangs rgyas rgyu/ /'di na snod min sems can gang yang med/ /bzhengs shig bzhengs shig stobs bcu mnga' ba'i lha/ /dus las mi 'da' thugs rje'i dbang gis na/ /sems can don la dgongs pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /yid kyis sprul zhing bshams pa'i gnas 'di ru/ /gtan pa med pa'i mchod sbyin spyan 'dren na/ /'khor dang bcas te ma lus gshegs su gsol/ /rgyal ba rgyal sras rang rgyal nyan thos dang | | lha srin sde brgyad 'gro drug sems can dang*/ /bgegs rnams gtan pa med pa'i mchod sbyin la/ /spyan 'dren 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol | | zhes spyan drangs pas/ mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su byon nas sprin gtibs pa bzhin du bzhugs par bsam/ de la pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ gyis so so la pad+ma'i gdan dbul/ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha la sogs pas mchod yon sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa lnga dang rol mo dbul/ de nas bsngo ba dngos ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bden pa dang*/ snying po dang | phyag rgya dang*/ gsang sngags dang*/ rig sngags dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi byin gyi brlabs dang*/ chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag pa'i mthu dang*/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i rgyu dang 'bras bu mi bslu ba'i byin gyi rlabs kyis sri zhu'i mgron du gyur pa sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ 'phags pa nyan thos la sogs pa thams cad la dbul lo/ /de rnams kyi pho brang dang gzhal yas khang du kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i spṛn rab 'byams rgya mtsho phyogs bcu nam mkha'i mthas klas pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams khyab pa'i rgyur gyur cig

yon tan gyi mgron du gyur pa/ mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa dang*/ lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin dang*/ rgyal po chen po bzhi dang*/ phyogs skyong bcu dang*/ gza' chen po brgyad dang*/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang*/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po gang ba bzang po dang*/ nor bu bzang po 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po yang dag shes dang*/ rgyal ba khyu mchog la sogs te phyogs mtshams srung bar byed pa'i gnod sbyin nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang*/ gnod sbyin mthu bo che sum cu rtsa gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ dpal ha ri ka dang*/ pañtsi ka la sogs te gtsug lag khang gi srung ma 'khor dang bcas pa dang | gzhan yang sangs rgyas dang*/ chos dang*/ dge 'dun la mngon par dad pa'i lha dang*/ klu dang*/ gnod sbyin dang*/ dri za dang*/ lha ma yin dang*/ nam mkha' lding dang*/ mi 'am ci dang*/ lto phye chen po btsun mo sras dang 'bangs su bcas pa rnams la 'bul lo/ /de rnams kyi pho brang du 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga bar snang la char bzhin bab/ sa gzhi la lo tog bzhin skyes/ nam mkha' la spṛn bzhin gtibs nas dgyes rab ky-i mchog mnyes rab kyi phul thob par gyur cig de rnams kyi spyan sngar phrin las dang snyan snyun du gsol ba ni/ bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa yun ring du gnas pa dang*/ bstan pa la bar chad byed pa thams cad zlog pa dang*/ zhi bar mdzad du gsol lo/ khyad par du yang bdag cag rnal 'byor pa 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi (《 zha 》+ yang ) bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*/ bde legs 'phel ba'i phrin las chen po mdzad du gsol | snying rje'i mgron du gyur pa 'gro ba rigs drug lam rgyud lnga skye gnas bzhis bsdus pa'i srid pa'i rtse mo nas/ dmyal ba'i gnas yan chad 'phags pa'i spyan gyis gzigs pa'i sems can thams cad la sbyin no/ /gsol lo/ / bsngo'o | | mgron no/ /de dag so so'i spyan lam dang mnga' ris su so so ci la dgyes pa dang*/

gang dag gang gis 'dul ba/ chos dang zang zing gi longs spyod ci 'dod pa thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig yul phyogs kyi lha mgon dang klu mgon du gyur pa/ sa bdag klu gnyan la'ang sbyin zhing stsal bas so so'i rnam par rig pa la ci 'dod pa thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig lan chags kyi mgron du gyur pa bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu sa dang bar snang la gnas nas 'dod pa'i gegs byed mi 'dod pa skyed par byed pa rnams dang*/ bdag cag gi tshe rabs kyi lan chags su gyur pa dang*/ 'phral gyi rkyen bgegs su gyur pa thams cad la'ang sbyin zhing stsal bas gnod pa'i bsam pa bsal nas phan pa dang*/ bde ba bskyed pa'i rgyur gyur cig gtan pa med pa'i mchod sbyin rgyal po 'di/ /chos nyid rnam par dag pa'i byin rlabs dang*/ /dkon mchog yon tan dpag med che ba dang*/ /snying po phyag rgya nges pa'i dam tshig dang*/ /rgyu rkyen rten 'brel tshogs pa'i nus mthu dang*/ /drang srong rig 'dzin rnams kyi grub pa dang*/ /bdag gi smon lam shes rab ting 'dzin gyis/ /ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phro/ / dbang po lnga yi longs spyod mkho dgur ldan/ /nam mkha'i mthas klas gter chen gyur pa 'di/ /mchod gnas bla ma khyed kyi pho brang du/ /mchod pa'i sprin gyis rgyas shing gtibs par smon/ /bdag gi bsod nams mthu yis ni/ / sems can thams cad bder gyur cig /kun kyang gnod pa rnams dang bral/ / yang na de bzhin gshegs gsungs pa'i/ /'dod pa phun sun tshogs gyur cig / sgrib pa med pa'i tshul gyis su/ /ma thogs par ni grub par shog /byol song gcig la gcig za ba/ /gnod pa de dag yang mi 'byung*/ /yi dwags rnams la zas dang skom/ /thogs pa med par 'byung gyur shog /sems can dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal gang*/ /mi bzad rnam pa sna tshogs pa/ /bsod nams 'di yi byin rlabs kyis/ /de dag myur du zhi gyur cig

/sa 'am mkha' la 'khod pa yi/ /lha klu gnod sbyin srin po dang*/ /'byung po mang po gang 'khod pa/ /dge ba'i bsam pa rdzogs gyur cig /chos kyi sbyin pa ni/ chos rnams thams cad rgyu las byung*/ / de rgyu de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs/ /rgyu la 'gog pa gang yin pa/ /dge sbyong chen pos 'di skad gsungs/ /sdig pa ci yang mi bya ste/ /dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad/ /rang gi sems ni yongs su gdul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ /lus kyi sdom pa legs pa ste/ /ngag gi sdom pa legs pa yin// yid kyi sdom pa legs pa ste/ /thams cad du ni sdom pa legs/ /thams cad srung ba'i dge slong dag /sdug bsngal kun las de grol lo/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun tu byung*/ /ngo bo nyid med gnas med pa// de ltar chos rnams shes gy-is la/ /sems can don ni mnyam med byos/ /'on kyang skyob pa'i sras su skye/ /zhes chos kyi sbyin pa byin la/ de ltar zang zing gi sbyin pas dbang po'i rgyud tshims/ chos kyi sbyin pas shes pa'i rgyud grol nas/ nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa gtan nas dag bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs lhun gyis grub nas mthar bla na med pa'i byang chub thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig byang chub ma thob kyi bar du yang rkyen dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig de nas bden pa'i stobs brjod par bya ste/ rgyan gyis brgyan par byas kyang chos spyod cing*/ /dul zhing yang dag sdom la tshangs par spyod/ /'byung po kun la chad pa spangs pa ni/ /dge sbyong dge slong de yin bram ze'ang de/ /'chi bas mi 'jigs gang yang med/ /'tsho ba'i srog la kun kyang 'dzem/ /rang gi lus la dpe long la/ /gzhan la gnod pa ma byed cig /ces lan gsum brjod do/
